data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
   

  

 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 As a Senior Project Manager, you are responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects, with a focus on retail and mixed\-use developments, from early concept through to completion.
   

  

 The role requires a highly proactive and commercially astute approach, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, brand requirements, operational constraints, and fast\-track retail programmes. You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.
   

  

 You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, provide leadership across multiple workstreams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Contract \& Scope
   

  

* Lead project set\-up, including contract finalisation, internal alignment and mobilisation of the team
* Fully understand and manage the contract, ensuring compliance with key obligations and deliverables
* Define, agree and manage scope across all disciplines, ensuring clarity of responsibilities
* Lead the appointment and coordination of sub\-consultants, including scope, fees and agreements
* Identify and manage changes to scope, leading variation preparation, negotiation and agreement with the client
* Ensure all deliverables meet WSP quality standards and client expectations


 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders
* Provide clear leadership, establishing a high\-performing “one team” culture
* Lead client engagement, workshops and presentations, including executive\-level reporting
* Manage complex stakeholder environments, including retail tenants, landlords, operators and authorities
* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)
* Ensure alignment between brand standards, operational requirements and technical design solutions
* Oversee design reviews, ensuring buildability, compliance and coordination across disciplines
* Drive high\-quality outputs through structured QA/QC processes
* Ensure coordination between landlord criteria and tenant requirements


 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management
* Identify key risks associated with retail phasing, tenant changes, authority approvals and programme constraints
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies
* Escalate critical risks to senior leadership and clients as required


 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance
* Lead preparation, negotiation and agreement of variations
* Provide commercial advice to clients, particularly relating to programme impacts and tenant\-driven changes


 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives
* Coordinate phased handovers, including base build and tenant fit\-out interfaces
* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 10\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a proactive and experienced Mid\-Level IT Project Manager in Sharjah to lead and coordinate IT and digital transformation projects. **Requirements:** 



* Experience managing medium\-scale IT infrastructure, software, systems integration, or smart technology projects.

* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Experience working with government entities

* Vendor and subcontractor management experience.
* Familiarity with MS Project.
* Strong communication in English (Arabic is a plus)
* Flexiblility to work with multiple time zones in Europe and US
* Valid UAE driving license and access to a personal vehicle

**Job Description – Expert, Special Projects** 




**Function:** 
 Strategy and Transformation
 



  





**1\. Role Purpose** 




 The Expert – Special Projects plays a critical role within the Strategy and Transformation function, leading high\-impact, strategic initiatives that are central to the organization’s value creation agenda. These initiatives form a core and sustained part of the Strategy and Transformation function’s mandate and require strong ownership, intellectual leadership, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into practical, high\-value outcomes.
 



 Reporting to the Group Director – Strategy \& Transformation, this role offers the opportunity to work directly on Board\- and leadership\-sponsored initiatives, shaping key decisions and driving measurable impact across the organization. The incumbent is expected to independently structure and solve complex problems, develop robust analytical insights, and lead cross\-functional execution to deliver sustainable business results.
 



 Operating within a fast\-paced, high\-performance environment, the role provides exposure to a collaborative and results\-driven team focused on driving growth, transformation, and enterprise\-wide success. It is suited for experienced professionals who thrive in dynamic environments, bring strong commercial acumen, and are motivated to deliver tangible impact and long\-term value.
 



  





**2\. Key Accountabilities** 




**Special Projects Delivery** 



* Lead assigned special projects from concept to completion, including problem definition, scoping, planning, execution, and closure
* Translate high\-level leadership directives into structured initiatives with clear workplans, milestones, and measurable outcomes
* Define project approach, methodologies, and success metrics to ensure practical and implementable solutions



  





**Types of Projects Managed** 




 Initiatives focused on unlocking step\-change value across the business—including revenue growth, market expansion, profitability uplift, and structural cost transformation—through rigorous analysis, zero\-based problem solving, and decisive performance interventions and Board/leadership\-driven strategic deep\-dives.
 



**Analysis \& Value Creation** 



* Conduct detailed quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, and performance improvement
* Perform financial analysis, including P\&L impact assessment, cost\-benefit analysis, and business case development
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and value\-driven recommendations



**Implementation** 



* Drive end\-to\-end implementation of initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to defined objectives
* Track progress, risks, and issues, and proactively resolve challenges to maintain delivery momentum
* Ensure recommendations are implemented with clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and sustainability



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Engage closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and align on solutions
* Influence and challenge stakeholders through fact\-based analysis and structured communication
* Coordinate across functions to ensure successful execution and sustained adoption of outcomes



**Reporting \& Executive Communication** 



* Prepare high\-quality executive presentations, business cases, and structured reports for senior leadership
* Present findings, recommendations, and progress updates to leadership forums
* Develop dashboards, trackers, and performance reports using tools such as Power BI and Excel



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Contribute to the development of tools, methodologies, and best practices for managing special projects
* Capture lessons learned and institutionalize successful approaches across the Transformation function



  





**3\. Skills Required** 




**Technical \& Professional Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, with ability to structure complex and ambiguous problems
* Solid financial analysis skills, including business case development, P\&L understanding, and value tracking
* Proven experience in project management and delivery of cross\-functional initiatives
* Advanced proficiency in:
* Excel (financial modelling, data analysis)
* Power BI (dashboarding, data visualization)
* PowerPoint (executive\-level presentations)



**Experience Requirements** 



* Approximately
 **10 years of relevant experience** 
 in strategy, transformation, consulting, or project\-driven roles
* **Preferred background in top\-tier or reputable consulting firms** 
 , or equivalent experience in transformation / strategy functions within large organizations
* Demonstrated experience in handling
 **ambiguous, high\-impact, leadership\-driven initiatives**



**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills** 



* Ability to operate independently in fast\-paced, high\-demand environments with multiple priorities
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across seniority levels
* Excellent communication skills—clear, structured, and concise
* High ownership, accountability, and results orientation
* Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative working style



**Core Competencies** 



* Structured thinking and attention to detail
* Commercial and value\-driven mindset
* Execution discipline and delivery focus
* Adaptability and learning agility

 Act as the main contact for internal teams, vendors, insurers, and DHA; provide updates to senior leadership and run workshops.

 Ensure alignment with DHA requirements, NABIDH onboarding, JCI standards, and data protection regulations.

 Bachelor’s (mandatory), PMP (mandatory), with preference for MBA or related certifications.

 7–10 years in healthcare IT project management

 Expertise in project methodologies (Waterfall/Agile) and tools

 This is a senior, project\-focused role requiring hands\-on experience delivering complex healthcare IT implementations in Dubai, with strong regulatory, technical, and stakeholder coordination expertise.

**What We’re All About.**

data.jd_text:
**What We’re All About.**
 It isn’t often you get to be part of a tech company that, since 2016, has been innovating the data analytics market in ways no\-one else can. Our technology started out in FinTech, helping tackle serious criminal activity. Now, its potential is virtually limitless.
   

  

 Working at Quantexa isn't just intellectually stimulating. We’re a real team. Collaborating and constantly engineering better and better solutions. We’re ambitious, we think things through and we’re on a mission to discover just how far we go. Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We’re made up of people from 47 nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.
   

  

 If our incredible culture sounds like you, we’d love you to join us.
   

  

**The opportunity.**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution and successful end\-to\-end delivery of implementation projects to our clients. You will join a wider Delivery team of engineers, analysts, data scientists and architects focused on achieving the best outcomes for our clients.
   

  

 You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.
   

  

 As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will also be working hand in hand with our delivery partner network, which includes the big four consultancies as well as major systems integrators.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing.**
* You will take full ownership of the delivery of Quantexa projects end\-to\-end, putting your arms around all aspects, actively mitigating risks and issues, driving high standards of quality and best practice and being in full control of the costs, timelines and scope.
* You’ll drive successful outcomes \- delivering projects in the most optimal way that realise maximum value to our clients.
* Managing the commercial and financial aspects of your projects, working with our clients to agree contracts for professional services, using both Time and Materials (T\&M) and Fixed Priced constructs.
* Coaching and mentoring your technical teams to ensure they have the skills and capabilities necessary to produce high quality deliverables to our clients.
* Working and learning with a high degree of autonomy with minimal supervision, seeking and knowing when to engage the rest of the Quantexa organisation for support.
* You will devise critical strategies to successfully manage your project stakeholders, both from the client as well as Quantexa leadership.


**What You’ll Bring.**
* You are an accomplished project management professional with strong leadership skills and a track record of delivering complex projects with excellent outcomes.
* You are an expert on project methodologies and approaches such as Agile, can apply them to maximum effect and you appreciate how these methodologies and approaches can scale to multiple teams and functions.
* You have broad stakeholder management experience either as a supplier delivering to clients, such as a consultancy or professional services organisation, or within a client\-side environment.
* You have experience of delivering large and complex data\-driven projects through the full software lifecycle.
* You have a good understanding of the technical aspects that impact the project outcomes and can grasp technical issues and devise mitigation strategies to address them.
* You have a strong appreciation of the business purpose and drivers of your projects and direct the team to ensure that achieving them is paramount.
* You are adept at operating in complex multi\-team environments where you harness your skills and knowledge to influence other teams to deliver the best overall outcome.
* You demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, critical thinking and the ability to devise delivery solutions to address client challenges.
* Exhibit strong technical communication skills with demonstrable experience of working in rapidly changing client environments.
* Have an excellent appreciation of what makes a high quality, operationally stable system and how to streamline all areas of development, release, and operations to achieve this.
* You are a self\-starter and bring a great deal of determination, initiative and tenacity to your projects.
* Proficiency in speaking Arabic at a fluent/native level is mandatory.
* Comfortable traveling within the UAE and across the Gulf region as required for business needs and client engagements.


**Ideal Candidates Will Also**
* Have worked on a variety of complex data orientated projects for financial services, government, and telco clients.


**Our perks and quirks.**
 What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.
   

  

**We Offer**
* Competitive salary \& Company bonus
* 22 days annual leave, plus national holidays \+ your birthday off!
* Private Healthcare, including dental \& optic cover
* Regularly bench\-marked salary rates
* Well\-being days
* Volunteer Day off
* Work from Home Equipment
* Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app
* Continuous Training and Development
* Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12\-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy
* Team Social Budget \& Company\-wide Socials


**Our mission.**
 We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start\-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.
   

  

**It’s All About You.**
 We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected \- because it’s your individuality and passion that make you
 *Q* 
 . We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible.
 **If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know \- we’re happy to assist.**
 No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

data.jd_text:
**ERP Project Manager \- MS dynamics 365** 




**Role Summary** 




 The ERP Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and successful delivery of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) projects across the organization. This role ensures that ERP implementations, upgrades, integrations, and optimization initiatives are completed on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.
 



 The ERP Project Manager acts as the primary point of coordination between business stakeholders, IT teams, implementation partners, and software vendors, ensuring seamless communication, effective change management, and successful user adoption of ERP solutions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project Planning \& Execution** 



* Lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation, upgrade, migration, and optimization projects.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
* Develop detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocation strategies.
* Monitor project progress and ensure milestones are achieved according to approved plans.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Manage project changes through established change control processes.



**Business Process Analysis** 



* Collaborate with business units to understand operational requirements and process improvement opportunities.
* Analyze existing business processes and recommend ERP\-enabled best practices.
* Ensure ERP solutions effectively support organizational goals and operational efficiency.



**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management** 



* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, and external consultants.
* Coordinate with ERP vendors and implementation partners to ensure project deliverables are met.
* Conduct regular project review meetings and communicate project status to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.



**ERP Implementation \& Integration** 



* Oversee ERP system configuration, customization, testing, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Coordinate data migration, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Manage integration between ERP systems and third\-party applications.
* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure successful issue resolution before deployment.
* Ensure compliance with system architecture standards, security requirements, and governance policies.



**Team Leadership** 



* Lead cross\-functional teams comprising business users, IT personnel, and external consultants.
* Assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure accountability for project deliverables.
* Promote collaboration, knowledge sharing, and effective communication among project participants.
* Mentor team members and support professional development where applicable.



**Change Management \& Training** 



* Develop and implement change management strategies to drive ERP adoption.
* Coordinate end\-user training programs, workshops, and knowledge transfer sessions.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of business processes, system configurations, and project deliverables.
* Support organizational readiness and transition planning during ERP deployment.



**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Ensure project deliverables meet agreed quality standards and business requirements.
* Monitor compliance with project governance frameworks and industry best practices.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and lessons\-learned sessions.
* Identify opportunities for system enhancements and continuous process improvement.



**Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree or MBA is preferred.



**Experience** 



* Minimum 5–10 years of project management experience.
* At least 3–5 years of hands\-on experience managing ERP implementation projects.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Odoo, Infor, Sage, or equivalent systems.
* Proven track record of managing large\-scale, cross\-functional projects and vendor relationships.



**Preferred Certifications** 



* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* Agile / Scrum Certification
* ERP Vendor Certifications (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, etc.)



**Required Skills \& Competencies** 




**Technical Competencies** 



* ERP implementation and lifecycle management.
* Business process analysis and re\-engineering.
* Data migration, system integration, and testing methodologies.
* Project planning and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera, Jira, etc.).
* Budget management and resource planning.
* Risk management and project governance.



**Leadership \& Soft Skills** 



* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Effective stakeholder and vendor management.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Decision\-making and conflict\-resolution skills.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* ERP project delivery within approved budget and timeline.
* Achievement of project milestones and implementation objectives.
* User adoption and satisfaction rates post\-implementation.
* Successful data migration and system integration outcomes.
* Reduction in project risks, issues, and change requests.
* Improvement in business process efficiency and operational performance.
* Compliance with governance, quality, and security standards.



**Working Conditions** 



* Full\-time position.
* May require travel between company locations, project sites, and business units.
* Availability to support critical implementation phases, testing cycles, and go\-live activities outside normal working hours when required.

Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. data.jd_text:
BlackStone eIT is seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead and deliver complex projects that drive our technology initiatives forward. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and finalizing projects according to strict deadlines and within budget. You will coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage resources, and communicate with stakeholders to ensure project success.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have extensive project management experience, strong leadership skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. You will play a critical role in shaping our project strategies and delivering high\-quality results that align with our organizational goals.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Oversee all aspects of project management including scope, schedule, cost, and quality management
* Develop detailed project plans, monitor progress, and adjust as necessary to meet deadlines and objectives
* Lead project teams, providing guidance, motivation, and support throughout the project lifecycle
* Engage stakeholders to define project expectations, track milestones, and report on project status
* Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure project continuity
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and teams
* Conduct post\-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and drive continuous improvement


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field
* Minimum of 10 years' experience in project management, preferably within IT or software development
* Proven track record of managing large, complex projects successfully
* Expertise in project management methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification is highly preferred


**Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* UAE Benefits
* Performance Bonus
* Training \& Development

data.jd_text:
Greeting for the day!
 



  





 We are seeking out for a Project manager
 



  





 About Us
 



  





 Algorithms Software is a leading technology company providing purpose\-built software to the construction industry for over 30 years, with a global footprint spanning five countries. We closed a Series A funding round from Norwest Venture Partners in 2022 and are accelerating growth and innovation.
 



  





 Our flagship construction management software, Xpedeon, unifies commercial, finance and supply chain workflows to optimise profitability across all construction project types. By
 



 eliminating blind spots, Xpedeon unlocks dynamic collaboration and operational efficiency from project start to closeout.
 



 Website: xpedeon.com
 



  





 Location: Dubai (WFO)
 



 Department: Consulting
 



 Reports to: Gulf Head
 



  





 Job Overview
 



 We are seeking a dynamic, client\-focused, and detail\-oriented ERP Project Manager with strong implementation experience to lead end\-to\-end ERP deployments. The role requires a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills and a strong ability to manage client relationships, commercial performance, and project risks.
 



 As a key liaison between the organization and clients, he/she will ensure timely and successful ERP implementation (with all sign offs and agreements on the delivery), maintain commercial health of projects, identify growth opportunities, and build a solid base for long\-term customer success.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. ERP Implementation \& Project Delivery
 



 • Lead ERP implementation projects from initiation through planning, execution, go\-live, and handover to support.
 



 • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
 



 • Coordinate cross\-functional teams (technical, Infra, functional, support) to meet project objectives.
 



 • Maintain up\-to\-date project plans, reports, and dashboards.
 



 2\. Communication \& Meeting Governance
 



 • Ensure right, timely, and effective communication with all stakeholders.
 



 • Draft clear, professional emails, documentation, and client communications.
 



 • Schedule and ensure meetings occur with required internal and client stakeholders.
 



 • Proactively communicate the importance of attendance and ensure no critical meeting lapses.
 



 • Prepare for meetings at least one day in advance with:
 



 o Updated project reports
 



 o Draft presentation (PPT)
 



 o Status and risk summaries
 



 • Prepare Minutes of Meeting (MOM) as per company template.
 



 • Circulate draft MOM for review, ensuring internal review time does not exceed 10–a5 minutes.
 



 • Issue final MOM with updated PPT and project reports on the same or next working day.
 



 3\. Action Tracking \& Follow\-Up
 



 • Track and follow up on all internal and external action items.
 



 • Ensure pending points are regularly monitored and resolved.
 



 • Maintain a structured action tracker and ensure accountability from all stakeholders.
 



 4\. Commercial \& Financial Oversight
 



 • Ensure the commercial health of the project.
 



 • Monitor billing milestones, billing, payments, and cost control.
 



 • Identify potential commercial risks and escalate proactively.
 



 • Coordinate with internal finance and client teams to prevent payment delays or contractual issues.
 



 5\. Risk Management
 



 • Identify project risks (timeline, scope, commercial, resource\-related, or client dependency).
 



 • Develop mitigation plans and coordinate with internal teams and client stakeholders.
 



 • Escalate critical risks in a timely and structured manner.
 



 6\. Client Relationship Management
 



 • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
 



 • Build long\-term, trust\-based client relationships.
 



 • Ensure smooth transition from implementation to support phase.
 



 7\. Sales, Upselling \& Account Growth
 



 • Identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities during implementation and post go\-live.
 



 • Coordinate with functional and sales team for solution presentations, proposal development, and commercial discussions.
 



  





  





 Key Requirements
 



 • 5\+ years of experience in ERP implementation as a Project Manager or Account Manager.
 



 • Proven track record in managing full\-cycle ERP implementations through go\-live and transition to support.
 



 • Strong client\-facing experience with excellent stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Experience managing commercial aspects of projects including billing, scope control, and financial performance.
 



 • Strong risk identification and mitigation capabilities.
 



 • Broad understanding of ERP systems and business processes, preferably in construction, engineering, or related industries.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong documentation and presentation abilities.
 



 • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and structured follow\-up.
 



 • Postgraduate qualification in Business, IT, Engineering, Accounts \& Finance, or a related field.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What Youll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programmes source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the teams capability to do the same


**What Youll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We Offer Colleagues The Opportunity To Drive Impact In The Region While They Learn And Grow. As a Full Time Careem Colleague, You Will Be Able To
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.


 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: http://www.careem.com Job Function: Project Management Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: Technology Information and Internet and IT Services and IT Consulting

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelors degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

 Overview
 



 A leading main contractor in the UAE is looking to appoint an experienced Project Director to lead the successful delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects across the region.
 



 The business has an established presence within the infrastructure sector and is currently delivering a portfolio of large\-scale developments including highways, bridges, utilities, public realm, and civil infrastructure works. This role will suit a commercially and operationally driven leader with extensive experience managing complex infrastructure projects from mobilisation through to handover.
 



 The Role
 



 As Project Director, you will hold full responsibility for the overall delivery, commercial performance, programme management, and stakeholder coordination of major infrastructure projects. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, manage client relationships, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead the delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects across the UAE
* Manage full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through to completion and handover
* Oversee project planning, programme management, construction strategy, and execution
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with contractual, commercial, and operational objectives
* Lead and manage project teams including construction, engineering, commercial, planning, and HSE functions

* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, contract requirements, and company standards
* Support business development activities and contribute to future project opportunities

 Project Focus
 



 This role is predominantly focused on:
 


* Roads and highway infrastructure
* Utilities and drainage networks
* Bridges and civil engineering works
* Public realm and infrastructure developments
* Large\-scale government and infrastructure projects



 Candidate Requirements
 



 To be considered for this role, candidates should have:

* Strong background delivering major roads and infrastructure projects in the UAE
* Extensive knowledge of civil engineering construction methodologies and project delivery
* Experience managing large multidisciplinary teams on complex infrastructure developments
* Strong commercial awareness and contract management experience
* Excellent stakeholder management and leadership capabilities
* Ability to manage programme delivery within fast\-paced project environments
* Strong communication, reporting, and client\-facing skills

* Strong public speaking and presentation skills

 What's on Offer
 


* Opportunity to lead high\-profile infrastructure developments across the UAE

* Dynamic and collaborative working environment



 If you are an experienced infrastructure professional looking to lead major civil engineering projects within a leading contractor environment, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon's Global Procurement Organization (GPO) is looking for a Social Responsibility Risk Manager to join the Social Responsibility Strategy \& Central Operations team within the Global Procurement Sustainability (GPS) organization. In this role, you will own the development, optimization, and continuous improvement of processes and frameworks that enable effective social responsibility (SR) risk management across Amazon's global supplier network. You will drive process excellence by designing and implementing scalable standard operating procedures, governance structures, and operational workflows that protect the fundamental dignity of workers and uphold human rights standards. This role requires a process\-oriented program manager who combines strong analytical skills with a hands\-on approach to building, measuring, and improving operational mechanisms. You must be a self\-starter with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end design, documentation, and continuous improvement of SR operational processes including SOPs, RACI frameworks, change management workflows, and governance structures to drive consistency and scalability across GPS programs
* Lead process optimization initiatives by identifying inefficiencies, establishing data\-driven baselines, and implementing measurable improvements across SR risk management operations such as vendor selection, audit coordination, and remediation tracking
* Develop and maintain SR process repositories, knowledge management tools, and centralized documentation to improve team visibility, access, and operational readiness across regional teams
* Drive stakeholder alignment and coordination across diverse internal teams and external partners by establishing structured communication cadences, escalation protocols, and cross\-functional governance mechanisms
* Lead complex, multi\-stakeholder projects from planning through execution, including vendor selection programs, supplier adoption strategies, and process framework development, with clear milestones, risk mitigation plans, and delivery commitments
* Build and maintain relationships with external suppliers, audit partners, and sustainability platforms, as well as internal stakeholders across GPO, to advance SR goals and ensure program alignment


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 2\+ years of supply chain experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
* 2\+ years of change management experience

**Job Description**
 Due to the continued success of our GEMS Wesgreen International School, Sharjah we are looking to recruit a dynamic Head of Inclusion supporting the whole school. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experience leader to take the next step in their career with a global leading company and within a world – class International and Outstanding BSO school.
   

  

 As a British Schools Overseas (BSO) accredited school, we proudly offer ECT, QTS, and iPGCE programmes through the TES Institute, reflecting our strong commitment to professional development.
   

  

 As Head of Inclusion, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on the direction and success of the school.
   

  

 The Head of Inclusion will be responsible for developing and implementing the school's inclusion strategy, ensuring that students with diverse learning needs are identified, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential.
   

  

 This role requires a passionate and experienced leader who can collaborate with teachers, parents, and external professionals to create an inclusive, differentiated learning environment that aligns with SPEA/ SSSD and SEND guidelines
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
*Inclusion Strategy \& Leadership:*
* Develop and lead the school’s Inclusion and SEN strategy in line with SPEA/ SSSD and GEMS policies. Drive a culture of inclusive education, ensuring that students with special educational needs, disabilities (SEND), EAL needs, and high potential (G\&T) learners are fully supported.
* Provide strategic guidance to the SEN team, Learning Support Assistants (LSAs), EAL teachers, and classroom teachers Develop, review, and implement Individual Education Plans (IEPs), intervention strategies, and progress tracking Student Support \& Intervention:
* Identify and assess students with SEND, EAL, or additional learning needs, ensuring early intervention and ongoing support.
* Work closely with teachers to differentiate instruction and provide tailored learning plans for students.
* Oversee exam access arrangements, accommodations, and curriculum modifications
* for students who require additional support.
* Monitor student progress through regular assessments, parent meetings, and intervention programs


*Collaboration \& Professional Development:*
* Train and mentor teachers in differentiated instruction, inclusive classroom strategies, and behavior management. Conduct CPD workshops to enhance teachers' understanding of SEND, EAL, and inclusion best practices.
* Work closely with parents, external specialists, and the school leadership team
* to ensure a cohesive support system for students.
* Liaise with SPEA and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance with inclusion standards and policies.


*Policy \& Compliance:*
* Ensure that Inclusion policies and procedures align with the Sharjah Inclusive Education Framework.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation, ensuring compliance with SPEA reporting and inspection requirements.
* Support the school’s Admissions team in assessing new students for learning support needs and guiding families on available resources.


**Skills**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Special Education, Psychology, Educational Leadership, or a related field
* (Master’s Degree in Special Education preferred)
* Recognized qualification in SEN/Inclusion/SEND coordination
* (e.g., NASENCO, SENCO qualification, PGCE with SEN specialization).
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Inclusion, SEND, or Learning Support leadership
* (preferably within a British curriculum or international school setting).
* Strong knowledge of SPEA \& SSSD guidelines, SEND Code of Practice, and Sharjah nclusive Education Framework
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to work effectively with students, parents, and staff.


 What we offer
   

  

* Four\-day working week
* Competitive tax\-free salary
* Individual, fully furnished accommodation
* Free schooling
* Private medical insurance
* Annual flight allowance
* End of service gratuity


 In addition, all staff have access to the GEMS Rewards app, offering a wide range of discounts and offers across travel, dining, retail and leisure, helping to enhance both lifestyle and savings while living in the UAE.
   

  

**GEMS Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all of its students and staff. A UK\-enhanced DBS or equivalent police check is a pre\-requisite for all appointments.**

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eatons Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.

 **Global Program engineer Manager \- Hyperscale Data Centers.**

This role ensures that Eaton delivers as One Eaton for hyperscale customers by coordinating post‑order activities across regions, business units, and functions.

data.jd_text:
**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Transformation Program Governance Director provides strategic oversight and leadership across the Group’s multi\-year digital transformation program. This role ensures disciplined execution, strategic alignment, and value realization across all streams, while acting as the guardian of program governance, standards, and vendor accountability. Operating at Group level, this leader drives cross\-entity alignment, embeds best\-in\-class governance frameworks, and establishes the program as a benchmark for disciplined transformation delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead executive governance for the entire digital transformation program, strategically allocating resources, budgets, and priorities to maximize business impact.
* Safeguard program outcomes by overseeing benefit realization and hold workstreams accountable for delivering measurable value and results.
* Support and challenge program leaders to ensure delivery excellence, proactively managing risks, dependencies, and barriers.
* Provide senior leadership with data\-driven insights, independent assurance, and strategic recommendations to guide decision\-making.
* Define, document and continuously evolve Group\-wide governance frameworks, standards, and policies to ensure consistent and mature program delivery.
* Establish and maintain a Transformation Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) offering tools, methodologies, and training for standardized delivery.
* Uphold governance rigor by designing and maintaining clear decision\-making structures, reporting mechanisms, and escalation protocols that ensure transparency and accountability at all levels.
* Act as a senior escalation point and manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring partners meet contractual commitments, quality standards, and timely delivery.
* Shape vendor engagement models and collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to optimize commercial terms, risk management and cost control across all vendor engagements.
* Ensure alignment across Group entities and business units, so that transformation initiatives are integrated seamlessly into the operating model and enable scalable adoption.
* Drive transparent, timely reporting and foster collaboration across geographies and functions to maintain senior stakeholder engagement and informed executive committees and SteerCos, enabling informed decision\-making and program steering.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Proven experience in leading governance and execution for large\-scale, multi\-year digital transformation programs, ideally in a multi\-entity or international group context.
* Deep expertise in governance design, operating models, and transformation frameworks, with a track record of institutionalizing standards at Group level.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to engage at C\-suite and Board level.
* Demonstrated success in vendor and partner governance, including complex system integrator or technology engagements.
* Strategic thinker with operational discipline, able to balance control, flexibility, and delivery speed.
* Excellent communication, diplomacy, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultures and functions.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
 To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
 It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
   

  

 We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose Summary**
 To provide overall leadership and management of Campus Physical Development Department and Campus Services. Ensures the effective operation of the University facilities management operation, projects and planning for university development and fit out needs. Travel Services unit (international travel, hotel accommodation and services, ground transportation, vehicle fleet management), the University Business/Service Centers (copying/duplicating, mail, office and classroom supplies and materials), University Switchboards, contract services (food services, convenience shop) and overseas the Conference Center. Supervises and develops the Campus Services Team to ensure high level of service and efficient departmental operations.
   

  

 CRITICAL SUCCESS FACTORS
   

  

 Must meet campus facility requirements in an effective, efficient and timely manner ensuring high quality and cost effectiveness within limited available space and existing resources. Lead the development and completion of complex, large projects in Dubai and Abu Dhabi Effectively represent the University with external stakeholders. Ensure successful operation of campus services and convention center management.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 LEADERSHIP
   

  

* Provides strategic and tactical leadership on large\-scale University projects as directed by university needs and management.
* Leads the development and update of campus master plans, the University’s facility plan and contributes to development of University’s capital budget(s).
* Through the Facilities Project Manager, provides overall leadership to construction, renovation projects and facilities related operation such as security, soft services MEP maintenance.
* Annually updates Department’s strategic plan and develops Department’s operating plan and budget.
* Represents Department in University’s management structure and processes, including the strategic planning process.
* Management of CPDS budget including proper and timely utilization of allocated budget.
* Develop and implement sustainability strategies aimed at achieving carbon cost\-neutral campuses.
* Champion environmentally responsible design and operations, including green building standards, energy efficiency, and resource conservation.


 QUALITY ASSURANCE
   

  

* Develops policies and procedures to ensure effective, efficient and safe operations of Department and University facilities.
* Ensures that the design and construction of renovation and construction projects meet University requirements, and are completed within budget, per specifications and on schedule.
* Ensures that facilities meet appropriate quality and safety regulations and standards and University needs.
* Ensures Department operates within University and Department regulations, policies, procedures and budget, and exhibits best professional and business practices.
* Ensures professional management for campus services including travel services, business center and convention center.
* Ensure effective management of university retail outlets and food services on campus.
* Lead the design and execution of robust Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans across the physical infrastructure and service domains.
* Ensure campus readiness through risk assessments, incident response protocols, and regular simulation exercises.
* Maintain compliance with national and international safety and resilience standards.


 SYSTEMS
   

  

* Develops a unified facilities University system to facilitate campus space and building changes, maintain accurate facilities inventories and “as built” drawings, support budget development and tracking, and support strategic planning.
* Through Facilities Management, provides overall leadership to the effective operation and maintenance of University facilities and building systems.
* Ensures facilities and building systems are operated and maintained in an effective and efficient manner.
* Oversees contracts for building systems maintenance, custodial, grounds maintenance and other contracted services.
* Oversees university services need and present to retail committee, and ensures management of business center, travel services and convention center.


 RELATIONSHIPS
   

  

* Represents the University and establishes effective working relationships and partnerships with University’s complex network of external contacts including consultants, contractors, public agencies, businesses and professional bodies.
* Establishes effective working relationships with the internal University community to ascertain their facility requirements.
* Recruits, supervises, evaluates and develops Department staff. In particular, manages Supervisor Facilities; Facilities Project Manager, Campus Services Managers and Department office staff.
* Review and optimize the CPDS organizational structure across campuses to enhance effectiveness, service quality, and cost\-efficiency.
* Works with University and government officials in the development and completion (design, tender, construction, commission and University occupancy) of new campus facilities.


**Other**
 DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE/COMPLEXITY OF ENVIRONMENT
   

  

 Infrastructure and facilities must keep pace with increase and needs of employees and students. Requirements must be met in an effective and efficient manner. Complex opportunities will need to be exploited towards University needs given existing resources and available space.
   

  

 Operates independently and regarded as a senior University professional and departmental leader who requires minimal direction. Ability to make decisions on a variety of issues including engineering, architectural, environmental, structural, ergonomic, economic, administrative, and aesthetic.
   

  

 WORKING RELATIONSHIPS/IMPACT OF INTERACTIONS
   

  

 Effective interaction with a variety of individuals sometimes working under stressful circumstances.
   

  

 Regular interaction with senior management and University community is essential when establishing and finalizing requirements for new and ongoing projects.
   

  

 Maintains close contact throughout negotiations with contractors, consultants through regular visits.
   

  

 Meets with government officials, Abu Dhabi and Dubai Municipality, Abu Dhabi Water and Electricity Authority and Dubai Water and Electricity Authority officials.
   

  

 Maintains contact with other universities and professional bodies for exchange of ideas.
   

  

**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Should possess a minimum of a Master’s Degree in engineering, architecture or related field and 15 years professional experience, where 5 years’ experience are in senior management experience, or an equivalent combination of education or experience.
   

  

**University Or Equivalent Experience Highly Preferred.**
 Project Management understanding and experience.
   

  

 Knowledge of Health and safety is required.
   

  

 Experience in the Middle East and bilingual language skills (English – Arabic) is ideal.
   

  

 COMPETENCIES
   

  

 Leadership \& Managerial Accountability \- Engages others to work together towards a shared vision and common goals; Makes effective decisions, achieve outcomes and results
   

  

 Communication \-Able to share information in an effective \& collaborative manner, both verbally and in writing.
   

  

 Customer \& Service Focused \- Demonstrates a spirit of service excellence
   

  

 Results \& Action Orientation \- Demonstrates initiative to generate improvements and foster positive outcomes.
   

  

 Builds Effective Interpersonal Relationships \- Demonstrates interpersonal effectiveness in the workplace.
   

  

 Knowledge \& Technical Competency \- Demonstrates proficiency in technical and job knowledge aspects of the position to achieve high level of performance. Able and willing to learn.
