data.jd_text:
**The School**
 Deira International School (DIS) is an Outstanding BSO\- and KHDA\-rated, award\-winning school located on a beautiful campus in Festival City, Dubai. In 2023, DIS was awarded the Education Excellence Award for ‘School Team of the Year’ and is also a Platinum Award holder for ‘Best Place to Work’, reflecting our strong commitment to staff wellbeing and a thriving school community.
   

  

**Education**
 With students aged 3–18, DIS is a not\-for\-profit school and part of the Al\-Futtaim Education Foundation. Founded in 2005, the school is renowned for providing an outstanding, inclusive, and holistic education. Our most recent inspection highlighted the following strengths:
   

  

* Staff are overwhelmingly proud of the school and believe it is well led, safe, and inclusive
* The quality of teaching, learning, and assessment across the school is outstanding
* Teachers have high expectations and consistently challenge pupils to do their best
* Staff feel respected, valued, and treated fairly
* The curriculum is precisely planned, well sequenced, and builds effectively on prior learning
* There is a strong focus on academic progress and achievement


 DIS is home to a diverse student body representing over 90 nationalities, which is fundamental to the school’s community ethos. Our exceptional facilities support a holistic approach to education, with rich opportunities across sport, performing arts, technology, leadership, creativity, and academic enrichment.
   

  

 Although non\-selective at admission, our students achieve exceptional examination results, comparable to top UK schools, and progress to leading universities worldwide. Digital literacy is embedded across the curriculum as we prepare students for the demands of a rapidly changing world.
   

  

 In the Early Years, our personalised, play\-based continuous provision ensures students are rigorously assessed against the EYFS framework, developing strong foundations for future learning. In Primary, pupils benefit from a broad and enriching curriculum, including a range of non\-core subjects. In Secondary, students complete IGCSEs in Year 11 before progressing to the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) or IB Career\-related Programme (IBCP) in Years 12 and 13\. DIS is governed by the Al\-Futtaim Education Foundation (AFEF), a not\-for\-profit initiative of the Al\-Futtaim family, supporting the vision of the Government of Dubai and KHDA to deliver future\-ready education while maximising positive social impact.
   

  

**The Role: Head of Performing Arts**
 We are seeking an exceptional and inspirational leader to join Deira International School as Head of Performing Arts. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a successful department encompassing Drama and Music within one of Dubai’s leading international schools.
   

  

 Performing Arts is a vibrant and highly valued part of school life at DIS. Both Drama and Music enjoy strong uptake at IGCSE and IB Diploma level, alongside extensive participation in co\-curricular activities, performances, ensembles, productions, and competitions. Students regularly engage in regional and international events through organisations such as COBIS and BSME.
   

  

 The department plays a central role in the wider life of the school, leading productions, concerts, recitals, showcases, assemblies, and celebration events throughout the year. Previous productions have included Oliver! and High School Musical. The successful candidate will continue to develop an ambitious and inclusive Performing Arts programme that inspires creativity and excellence.
   

  

 The department benefits from excellent facilities, including a dedicated drama studio, specialist music spaces, rehearsal rooms, and a multipurpose hall with full stage and performance equipment.
   

  

 As Head of Performing Arts, the successful candidate will lead curriculum development, teaching and learning, enrichment, and departmental improvement across Drama and Music. They will be a visible and enthusiastic leader who inspires students and staff while promoting collaboration, innovation, and high expectations.
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate**
* A clear vision for excellence in Performing Arts education
* The ability to inspire, motivate, and develop others
* Excellent organisational and communication skills
* A commitment to collaboration and positive relationships
* High expectations of student achievement and participation
* A passion for enrichment and the wider life of the school
* Confidence leading productions, performances, and events


**The Successful Applicant Will Be Required To Have**
* Experience teaching GCSE Drama, with A Level and/or IB experience desirable
* Leadership experience within Performing Arts
* A B.Ed. or degree in a related subject, plus PGCE/PGDE or equivalent
* A proven track record of outstanding teaching and learning
* Experience leading or supporting productions and enrichment programmes
* A belief in the potential of every student to achieve highly
* The ability to contribute fully to the wider life of the school and inspire participation across Performing Arts

Who We Are
   

  

 BioMarin is a leading rare disease biotechnology company focused on genetically defined conditions.
   

  

 Guided by our purpose to develop medicines that make a profound impact on people’s lives, our global teams have delivered a portfolio of therapies since our founding in 1997\. Our revolutionary treatments for conditions like achondroplasia (the most common form of dwarfism), PKU (phenylketonuria), CLN2, a form of Batten disease, and a number of forms of MPS (mucopolysaccharidosis) offer new possibilities for patients and families who previously had few, if any, available options. More recently, with the close of the Amicus acquisition, our portfolio has expanded to include therapies for Fabry disease and Pompe disease, expanding our ability to reach more people living with rare genetic conditions.
   

  

 Our success comes from our unwavering commitment to excellence, our deep understanding of patient needs, our scientific expertise, and our world\-class manufacturing capabilities. data.jd_text:
Job Purpose
 



 The Project Director will be responsible for the overall leadership, management, and successful delivery of large\-scale roads and infrastructure construction projects across the UAE. The role requires strategic oversight of project execution, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual, quality, and regulatory requirements. The Project Director will lead multidisciplinary project teams, manage client relationships, and drive operational excellence across all assigned projects.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Project Leadership \& Management
 


* Provide strategic direction and leadership for multiple roads and infrastructure projects from award through completion.
* Ensure successful execution of projects in accordance with contract requirements, budgets, schedules, and quality standards.
* Develop and implement project execution plans, resource strategies, and risk mitigation measures.
* Monitor project performance and take corrective actions to ensure project objectives are achieved.
* Oversee project planning, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover activities.



 Client \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, government authorities, and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Lead progress meetings, technical discussions, and commercial negotiations with stakeholders.
* Represent the company in meetings with government authorities including municipalities, transport authorities, and utility providers.



 Commercial \& Contract Management
 


* Ensure effective management of project budgets, cash flow, cost control, and profitability.
* Review contractual obligations and ensure compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Manage variations, claims, extensions of time, and dispute resolution processes.
* Support the commercial team in project valuations, payments, and final account settlements.

data.jd_text:
**About Us** 




 Keeta, the international subsidiary of global delivery leader Meituan, is driven by a clear mission: We help people eat better, live better. Building on our parent company's 16 years of technological and operational expertise mastered in China, we are leading a global transformation in food and consumer product delivery. Since our start in 2023, Keeta has focused on creating value for every part of the communities we serve. We provide a reliable experience for consumers, enhance technology and operations for restaurants, and create more earning opportunities and greater safety for courier partners. This commitment to shared progress drives our journey from Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East and into Brazil, with the world ahead.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



1. Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to support logistics operations — providing real\-time visibility across delivery performance, courier efficiency, and supply\-demand balance
2. .Lead deep\-dive analytics on key delivery metrics including ATA (Arrival Time Accuracy), order fulfilment rates, and last\-mile efficiency — translating insights into actionable recommendations for operations teams
3. .Develop quantitative models for capacity planning, workforce scheduling, and demand forecasting to support sustainable growth in the UAE market
4. .Own data storytelling for weekly and monthly business reviews — ensuring KPI visibility and driving alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders
5. .Partner with Product, Operations, and Finance teams to define metrics frameworks, evaluate new initiatives, and embed a data\-driven decision\-making culture
6. .Lead and develop a team of 4–5 data analysts — setting direction, building capability, and fostering a high\-performance analytics culture



  





**What We Need From You** 



* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics, with 2\+ years of team management experience.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R — with hands\-on experience building pipelines, dashboards, and analytical models.
* Strong background in internet, technology, or on\-demand platform companies — experience in food delivery, logistics, or last\-mile operations is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in both English and Chinese (Mandarin) — this role operates across a bilingual team environment.
* Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.



  





**What Makes This Role Exciting** 




 This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of data science and last\-mile delivery operations — with direct impact on how Keeta serves millions of users across the UAE. You'll be reporting into the Head of Logistics and building the data foundation that powers one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East. With a newly formed team and a high\-growth market, this is a genuine opportunity to shape how data\-driven decisions are made at scale — from the ground up.
 



  





**Why Join Keeta** 



* **Global scale, local impact** 
 — Keeta is Meituan's international arm, backed by 16 years of technology and operational expertise, and one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East.
* **Real ownership from day one** 
 — You'll lead a team, shape data infrastructure, and directly influence how the business makes decisions at scale.
* **Work with top talent globally** 
 — Collaborate with teammates from over 40 countries in a fast\-moving, high\-performance environment.
* **Accelerate your career** 
 — We move fast, operate across multiple markets, and give ambitious people the space to grow beyond what a traditional role could offer.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

data.jd_text:
We are a leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, with one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. Our business model promotes tower infrastructure sharing and enables mobile network operators (MNOs) to deliver mobile connectivity more quickly, reliably, cost\-effectively and with a lower carbon footprint. In turn, this supports the expansion and quality of mobile connectivity, driving sustainable development in our markets.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build, acquire, lease\-up and operate telecommunications towers that can accommodate and power the needs of multiple tenants. Our tenants are the major Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) and we serve them across nine high\-growth markets (8 in Africa and Oman in the Middle East). Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.
   

  

**Overview**
 Reporting to the Group Director of SOC \& Systems (or relevant Group Operations leader), you will play a pivotal role in leading the transformation of a distributed, multi\-market NOC environment into a digitally enabled Smart Operating Centre.
   

  

 This is a Group\-level transformation leadership role responsible for embedding governance discipline, strengthening cross\-market accountability, integrating core operational systems, and delivering measurable improvements in uptime, energy efficiency, SLA compliance and operational performance across nine markets.
   

  

**Location** 
 : Dubai
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
 As the Group SOC \& Systems Senior Manager, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading the transformation and standardisation of multi\-OpCo NOC operations into a unified Smart Operating Centre model
* Embedding structured governance frameworks, escalation discipline and audit trail compliance across all markets
* Driving integration across RMS, ServiceNow, ERP, ICCP and workforce management platforms to create a single operational view
* Strengthening incident management processes, improving MTTR and ensuring SLA\-driven operational excellence
* Enhancing real\-time telemetry utilisation, alarm\-to\-action automation and predictive analytics capabilities
* Managing and influencing cross\-market stakeholders and third\-party field service partners without direct line authority
* Improving uptime engineering, energy optimisation and fuel governance across site portfolios
* Establishing clear accountability frameworks, KPIs and operational value metrics (e.g. truck roll reduction, SLA penalty avoidance, fuel efficiency)
* Translating technical operational issues into financial and business impact for executive stakeholders


**Requirements For The Role**
 To succeed in this role, you will have:
   

  

* At least 10 years’ experience in infrastructure or mission\-critical operations, including NOC, SOC or control centre environments
* Demonstrable experience leading multi\-country or multi\-site operational environments
* Strong expertise in real\-time telemetry, alarm environments, incident management and SLA\-driven operations
* Experience integrating or optimising platforms such as RMS, ServiceNow, ERP, ICCP or workforce management systems
* Proven ability to embed governance discipline, structured escalation frameworks and operational accountability across complex organisations
* Experience managing outsourced field service ecosystems and third\-party partners
* Strong stakeholder management capability, with experience influencing senior leaders across multiple markets
* A structured, resilient and assertive leadership style, comfortable challenging underperformance where required
* Experience operating in emerging markets environments
* Knowledge of telecommunications, tower infrastructure, energy systems or hybrid power environments is highly advantageous.


**Desired Skills**
* Stakeholder Management
* Operational Governance \& Compliance
* Incident \& Escalation Management
* Digital Transformation \& Systems Integration
* KPI Framework Design \& Performance Measurement
* Predictive Analytics \& Automation Enablement
* Business Performance Management
* Knowledge of French language (advantageous)


**Benefits**
* Competitive basic salary
* Discretionary bonus
* Health insurance
* Life insurance


 Helios Towers is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. You and any job applicants will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief.

data.jd_text:
Are you ready to turn AI strategy into measurable commercial outcomes that elevate how we reach and support patients across fast\-evolving markets? From a leadership seat in Dubai, you will connect senior regional priorities with cutting\-edge AI delivery to shape how our field, marketing, access and medical teams engage customers and make decisions at speed.
   

  

 In this role, you act as the embedded translator between regional business leaders and our AI organization, owning the lifecycle of high\-impact AI solutions—from idea to adoption to value realization. You will sit with regional leadership, partner closely with enterprise AI and technology teams, and lead the charge on AI programs that power next\-best engagement, dynamic insights and agentic platforms. How would you convert complex, cross\-market needs into scalable AI programs that deliver clear ROI and sustained business value?
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Customer Engagement: Lead the transformation of Interational go\-to\-market model across personal and non\-personal channels — commercial operations, salesforce excellence in partnership with the therapy areas, and digital and omnichannel — to improve effectiveness, drive personalization, and lift the impact of customer engagement.
* Strategy and Portfolio Ownership: Own the regional portfolio of AI commercial programs; create and sequence a clear roadmap aligned to business, medical, access and R\&D priorities; develop business cases and value narratives; embed reuse principles to scale what works.
* Use Case Translation: Engage senior stakeholders to surface unmet needs and decision points; translate them into well\-scoped AI use cases with clear problem statements, success metrics, data requirements, and risk tiering; align to strategic focus areas including AI30\.
* Delivery, Scale and Value Realization: Co\-lead solution delivery with enterprise AI teams; shape pilots, manage scaled deployments and local adoption; define and track KPIs and ROI; apply appropriate evidence frameworks; remediate or decommission where needed.
* Change Leadership and Ways of Working: Lead structured stakeholder engagement; embed AI into day\-to\-day operations, moving beyond one\-off pilots; identify process and role shifts and work with functional leaders to implement them; partner with learning teams to build AI literacy.
* Data, Governance and Compliance: Serve as regional point of contact to ensure AI\-ready data and compliance with enterprise standards and local regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, AI Act, SaMD); adhere to governance requirements including registry\-before\-scale, model/data cards, ongoing monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop oversight.
* Partnerships and Ecosystem: Co\-develop programs with Commercial AI and Global Business Services; establish clear remits and hand\-offs across enterprise teams; build a delivery culture grounded in shared purpose, psychological safety and accountability.
* Integration with Enterprise AI: Act as the primary interface to capability teams across customer and patient engagement, data science and analytics, and platform engineering, ensuring clarity on ownership, priorities and transitions from build to run.
* Market Sensing and Foresight: Scan internal and external trends; track market and innovation shifts to anticipate opportunities and risks; spot and shape new enterprise initiatives; define leading indicators to monitor progress and pivot decisively.
* Near\-term to Broader Impact: In the first 90 days, assess demand, set the roadmap and launch priority pilots; in 6–12 months, scale adoption across markets, demonstrate ROI and codify reuse; over time, institutionalize AI\-enabled ways of working that accelerate growth and improve patient outcomes.


**Essential Skills / Experience**
* Minimum 10 years professional experience, with 5\-7 years focus on leading transformation programs in commercial pharma
* Demonstrated commercial and scientific domain experience reflecting a deep understanding of the needs of the business function and Region you are responsible for.
* Strong analytical and communication skills at all levels of the organization and the ability to operate successfully in highly matrixed organizations
* Effective interpersonal and relationship management skills with consultative approach and ability to interact and build trust
* Operational effectiveness, highly organized process with follow through
* Strong initiative to understand our core business goals and establish processes or programs to set direction, generate alignment and push forward
* Financial background and understanding of forecasts, budgets, financial activities and tools
* Resourceful, motivated, influential and proactive; able to prioritize in a fast\-growing organization
* Experience in strategic planning processes and tools and/or project management tools


**Desirable Skills / Experience**
* Graduate degree (MBA, Masters, MD or PhD preferred)
* Experience in leading and managing alliances or strategic partnerships
* Experience in translating business needs into a coordinated business proposal and plan for cross\-functional senior leadership team
* Ability to develop creative and simple solutions to complex problems


*You will be empowered with local ownership to shape how AI changes commercial impact across diverse markets, supported by leaders who invite bold ideas and open dialogue. Lead from Dubai to turn high\-potential AI into scaled impact—step into this role and build what’s next for patients, customers and growth!*

You will be a trusted advisor to the client and collaborate with them on identifying best practices within the talent mobility industry. The position works closely with client contact(s) to provide seamless customer service and maximize Sirva's value to the client.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client Consulting and Issue Resolution (50%)**
* Provide communication link between Sirva and the Client regarding relocation issues, household good issues, service level agreements and projects.
* Acts as a trusted advisor to the client and collaborates with them on identifying best practices within the talent mobility industry.
* Plays a key role in identifying solutions and resolving client issues across the client team and/or in partnership with other operational divisions.
* Exercise solid business judgment while making decisions and addressing transferee/assignee and client issues.


**Collaboration with Global Account Management (20%)**
* Assist with upselling and overall project management, including the management and calculation of client SLA results.
* Provide support, as requested, with client implementations.
* Collate and validate data and content for Client Reviews and Governance meetings.
* Work with the account management team to establish delivery of strategic account plans with understanding and recognition of all global and regional requirements.
* Works collaboratively with the Account management and the client team to understand the client delivery requirements and drive client profitability and revenue growth.


**Internal Consulting (20%)**
* Works with the Customer Experience teams to help educate on client policies and preferences.
* Collaborates with internal teams, management and VP/Director, Global Account Management to ensure client performance metrics are implemented, maintained, measured and achieved.
* Partner with local business development teams to support acquisition of new business
* Oversees VIP moves internally to ensure they are successful for the customer and Sirva.


**Reporting (10%)**
* Collaborates with Analytics team to ensure successful delivery of client reporting.
* Serves as a consultant for all client divisions/departments who need assistance with reporting such as: volume, performance metrics, relocation and assignment costs, budgeting and accrual.
* Keeps clients informed of available client reports and new products and services, and helps to encourage and ensure understanding and increased usage of the available tools and products.

* Strong organizational skills
* Strong verbal, written communication and presentation skills (English and Arabic preferred).

* Proficient with productivity and reporting applications e.g. Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams), etc.

* NO

data.jd_text:
**TGP International**
 WE CREATE, DESIGN AND BUILD AWARD WINNING WORLD\-CLASS F\&B AND RETAIL BRANDS FOR OUR CLIENTS AND PARTNERS
   

  

 TGP International are a hospitality consultancy based in London and Dubai. We team up with passionate brands, clients and entrepreneurs to make their long\-term vision a reality through concept development, creative interior design, graphic design \& branding, franchising, advisory \& operational services and project management.
   

  

 Some of our clients include: Dubai Expo 2020, Marriott, Hilton, Waldorf Astoria, Harrods, Sushi Samba, Adrift Burger Bar, Nakheel Malls, Selfridges, Time Out Market, FIFA World Cup 2022, The National, and Tashas.
   

  

**Do you have a real passion for food and hospitality? Are you a foodie? Does the idea of creating world\-class restaurants, food halls and F\&B excite you?**
 As the world's leading hospitality agency, offering an outstanding 360 degree service to our clients, we are constantly striving to be the best and lead the sector in F\&B and hospitality consultancy. We need a driven and creative person to join our fun and dynamic team and have a direct contribution and client exposure on some of the world's leading projects.
   

  

**Requirements**
**The Role:** 
 Strategy \& Masterplanning Director
   

  

**The job location can be from any of our offices: London, Cairo, Dubai, Riyadh**
 The Strategy \& Masterplanning Director is responsible for leading and growing TGP's Strategy \& Masterplanning practice, ensuring the successful delivery of all strategic advisory projects while driving innovation, client satisfaction, commercial performance, and team development.
   

  

 As a senior client advisor, the Director will build trusted relationships with clients, taking the time to deeply understand their challenges, ambitions, operational realities, and commercial objectives. They will be responsible for translating complex business problems into clear strategic questions, designing analytical approaches that uncover actionable insights, and developing tailored solutions that create measurable value for clients.
   

  

 The Director will lead multidisciplinary teams through large\-scale research, data analysis, market evaluation, and strategic planning processes, transforming complex findings into compelling narratives, creative strategies, and inspirational recommendations that distinguish TGP from traditional consultancies.
   

  

 The role will also play a key part in growing TGP's market presence by identifying opportunities to expand client relationships, develop new service offerings, and position TGP as the leading hospitality strategy and experience consultancy in the region.
   

  

 The Director is responsible for upholding TGP's values, maintaining the reputation of the Advisory department, and acting as a champion of TGP's 5E Customer Service philosophy.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Strategy, Masterplanning \& Client Advisory


**Strategic Leadership**
* Lead the development, delivery and implementation of client\-facing hospitality strategy projects including:
* Master Planning
* Feasibility Studies
* Throughput Analysis
* Management Consultancy Services
* Operational Consultancy Services
* Brand Curation Services
* Market Assessments
* Concept Development
* Destination Strategy
* Asset Positioning
* Act as the senior strategic advisor on all strategy projects
* Lead project scoping, methodology development, timelines, resource planning, and delivery frameworks
* Provide final review and approval of all strategic outputs, recommendations, reports, and presentations
* Drive the evolution of TGP's strategic advisory services, methodologies, tools, and intellectual property


**Client Management \& Relationship Development**
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term client relationships founded on trust, credibility, and strategic value
* Invest time in understanding client businesses, operational challenges, investment objectives, stakeholder priorities, and market context
* Facilitate workshops, interviews, and stakeholder engagement sessions to identify root causes of business challenges rather than simply responding to stated requirements
* Translate client needs into tailored strategic solutions that align with commercial, operational, and brand objectives
* Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships through cross\-selling, upselling, and introduction of wider TGP services
* Position TGP as a strategic partner rather than a transactional consultant


**Problem Definition \& Analytical Leadership**
* Lead teams through structured problem\-solving methodologies to clearly define client challenges and project objectives
* Design analytical frameworks and research methodologies that support evidence\-based decision making
* Guide teams through large and complex data analysis exercises, including market, operational, financial, customer, and competitive data
* Ensure insights are derived from data in a way that remains focused on solving client business problems rather than simply reporting findings
* Challenge assumptions and identify emerging trends, opportunities, risks, and innovation opportunities
* Drive clarity and alignment when working with ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting information


**Insight\-Led Strategy \& Innovation**
* Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling, and actionable strategic recommendations
* Develop creative and inspirational strategies that combine commercial rigour with innovative thinking
* Ensure recommendations are grounded in insight while pushing clients towards differentiated and future\-focused solutions
* Lead the creation of compelling strategic narratives that inspire confidence and support decision making
* Champion innovation, thought leadership, and trend analysis to ensure TGP remains ahead of industry developments
* Create strategic outputs that differentiate TGP from traditional consultancies through a combination of insight, creativity, practicality, and implementation focus
* Test new methodologies, technologies, and approaches while tracking effectiveness and outcomes
* Actively participate in TGP's 360 process from a strategic perspective
* Attend weekly Advisory and Design meetings to update leadership on project performance, team workload, and strategic opportunities
* Finance \& Profitability
* Monitor project billing, collection, and financial performance
* Develop and contribute to territory business plans and growth strategies
* Maximise revenue opportunities across strategy projects and wider TGP services
* Ensure profitability targets and project margins are achieved
* Negotiate third\-party consultant fees and supplier agreements
* Assess project feasibility and risk prior to partner approval
* Develop management information systems and performance reporting to support business growth and resource planning
* Contribute to annual budgeting and forecasting processes
* Review quarterly forecasts and identify performance variances
* Monitor territory profit and loss performance and recommend corrective actions where required
* Project Leadership


 (Where assigned as Project Lead)
   

  

* Coordinate and chair project meetings
* Manage project programmes, deliverables, and stakeholder communications
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to TGP quality standards
* Attend site visits, workshops, and client presentations
* Provide strategic leadership and subject matter expertise throughout project delivery
* Manage relationships with all external stakeholders
* Obtain stakeholder feedback and approvals as required
* Facilitate collaboration across TGP departments to ensure integrated project delivery
* Ensure strategic recommendations remain aligned with brand, commercial, and operational objectives
* Manage effective project handover between departments and project phases
* People Leadership
* Lead recruitment, retention, and development of the Strategy \& Masterplanning team
* Approve all strategy team recruitment decisions
* Develop workforce planning and resource allocation strategies
* Mentor and coach team members in consulting, analytical thinking, client management, and strategic problem solving
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Conduct monthly team meetings and regular performance reviews
* Develop personal development plans and career pathways for team members
* Lead intern and graduate development programmes
* Ensure resources are effectively managed to meet client commitments
* Communicate resource requirements and capacity challenges to the Leadership Team
* Business Development \& Market Growth
* Actively build market presence through conferences, industry events, thought leadership, and networking activities
* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and generate new business opportunities
* Lead strategic pitches, proposals, and presentations
* Support marketing initiatives with market insights, project learnings, and thought leadership content
* Maintain awareness of market trends, investor activity, hospitality innovation, and competitive movements
* Drive client retention, satisfaction, and long\-term relationship growth through TGP's 5E Customer Service philosophy
* Promote TGP's integrated 360 service offering across all client engagements
* Contribute to positioning TGP as the leading hospitality strategy, masterplanning, and experience consultancy in the region


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Economics, Real Estate, Urban Planning, Architecture, Strategy, or a related discipline
* Master's Degree (MBA or equivalent) desirable


**Experience**
* Minimum 10 years' experience in hospitality consulting, real estate advisory, strategy consulting, destination development, or management consultancy
* Minimum 2 years in a senior leadership role
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale strategic advisory projects
* Strong understanding of GCC hospitality, tourism, mixed\-use, and destination development sectors
* Experience managing senior client relationships and executive stakeholders
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex analytical and strategic challenges


**Technical Skills \& Knowledge**
* Strategic Planning \& Business Transformation
* Hospitality \& Destination Strategy
* Masterplanning \& Feasibility Analysis
* Financial Modelling \& Commercial Analytics
* Market Research \& Data Analysis
* Client Relationship Management
* Facilitation \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Innovation \& Concept Development
* Business Development \& Proposal Writing
* GCC Market Knowledge
* Presentation \& Storytelling Skills
* Leadership \& Team Development


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic Thinking
* Commercial Acumen
* Client Centricity
* Analytical Problem Solving
* Creativity \& Innovation
* Executive Presence
* Influencing \& Negotiation
* Communication \& Storytelling
* Leadership \& Coaching
* Collaboration \& Team Building
* Results Orientation


**Benefits**
 TGP International Employee Benefits:
   

  

 Five\-Day Work Week: Standard Monday to Friday schedule.
   

  

 Hybrid Work Arrangement: Three days in the office and two days working remotely.
   

  

 Incentive Plan: Company incentive scheme offering up to 10%—5% for introductions and 5% for successful closures.
   

  

 Annual Leave: 22 working days of paid annual leave, excluding weekends.
   

  

 Remote Work Flexibility: One additional week per year to work remotely from your home country, which can be combined with up to two consecutive weeks of annual leave.
   

  

 Coaching \& Mentoring: Structured professional development through a dedicated coaching and mentoring program.
   

  

 Annual Company Gathering: A global team event bringing together employees from all offices.
   

  

 Employee Recognition Program: Regular recognition initiatives celebrating outstanding performance and contributions.

data.jd_text:
**About Us:** 




  





 talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50\+ countries
 **.** 




  





**About this rol** 
 e:
 



  





 We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real\-time tracking and payments.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
 



  





 We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




  




* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer\-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross\-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat



  





**What success looks like:** 




  





**By 90 days** 
 : You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
 



**By 6 months** 
 : Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
 



**By 12 months** 
 : You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
 







**Qualifications** 




  





**You must have** 



* 6\+ years of hands\-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform)
* 2\+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade\-offs between native vs cross\-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K\+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data



  





**Bonus if you have** 
 :
 


* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk\-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) or event\-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e\-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams



  





**This role is for you if...** 



* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought



  





**This role is NOT for you if...** 



* You want a pure people\-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow\-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices



  





 Additional information
 



  





**Your career growth path:** 




 Talabat operates a structured career framework with clearly defined levels for engineering leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, you'll enter an established progression that rewards growing impact, strategic ownership, and people leadership:
 



**Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
 



**Senior Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain\-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
 



**Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
 



**Senior Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company\-wide technical strategy, build director\-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.

**Assistant Conference Producer**
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Conference Producer to help lead the research, development, and delivery of high\-quality conferences. The ideal candidate will be responsible for assisting in creating compelling agendas, securing senior\-level speakers and attendees, and ensuring each event delivers strong value for delegates, sponsors, partners, and stakeholders.
   

  

 This role requires excellent research, communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. The successful candidate will be confident engaging with C\-level executives and senior industry leaders across international markets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Research \& Programm Development:**
* Help research industry trends, market developments, and audience needs
* Help develop commercially viable conference agendas and event concepts
* Identify key discussion topics and emerging market opportunities
* Conduct competitor analysis and market mapping of industries into buyer and seller chains
* Research and build databases of target individuals suitable for speaking at events or attending advisory board meetings


**Identify targets according to:**
* Seniority level (e.g. CIO, CTO, CSO)
* Geographic focus
* Major companies within target markets
* Client recommendations


**Speaker Acquisition \& Management**
* Identify, approach, and secure senior\-level approved speakers and industry experts
* Invite, follow up, and confirm approved speakers via LinkedIn, email, and phone
* Achieve agreed monthly speaker confirmation targets across assigned events
* Build and maintain strong relationships with speakers, sponsors, clients, and industry stakeholders
* Manage and maintain accurate speaker invitation trackers at all times
* Keep live event agendas updated with confirmed speakers and allocated sessions
* Collect professional bios and high\-resolution speaker photos immediately upon confirmation
* Ensure event websites are continuously updated with speaker profiles and agenda changes


 Act as the main point of contact for all speaker communications regarding:
   

  

* Event participation
* Session content
* Travel and accommodation arrangements
* Event logistics and queries


**Assist with speaker travel budget allocation where required**
* Collect and organize speaker documentation needed for local event licensing procedures
* Send detailed speaker briefing documents covering both content and logistics
* Ensure speakers are fully briefed and event\-ready at least two weeks before the event
* Organize and attend Meet the Panel briefing sessions for moderators and panelists via Zoom or Microsoft Teams
* Ensure moderators distribute final discussion workflows ahead of sessions


**Advisory Board Management**
* Invite and secure approved advisory board participants through LinkedIn, email, and phone outreach
* Secure targeted attendance numbers for advisory board meetings conducted via Zoom or Microsoft Teams


 Coordinate meeting logistics including:
   

  

* Sending Teams/Zoom invitations
* Distributing agendas in advance
* Managing confirmations and reminders


 Attend and record advisory board meetings where applicable
   

  

**Maintain accurate attendee records including:**
* Names
* Job titles
* Company details
* Contact information


 Export and manage attendee data from meeting platforms where required
   

  

 Collect attendee bios and high\-resolution photos and ensure prompt website updates
   

  

**Event Project Management**

* Coordinate closely with sales, marketing, sponsorship, and operations teams
* Ensure all programm content and speaker deliverables are completed on time
* Maintain high standards of organization and communication throughout the production cycle
* Support onsite event delivery and attend events where required
* Assist the Content Director with ad hoc research, production tasks, and event support


**Marketing \& Website Coordination**

* Upload and maintain accurate speaker bios, photos, session details, and advisory board information across event platforms
* Assist with the development and review of marketing copy including agenda descriptions, speaker highlights, email campaigns, and social media content
* Ensure all website content is accurate, professional, and aligned with brand standards and event timelines
* Support marketing initiatives by identifying compelling content and speaker announcements to help drive delegate registrations and engagement


**Commercial Support**
* Work closely with sponsorship and delegate sales teams to support event revenue goals
* Prepare sponsorship brief for each event detailing buyer seller categories with examples, why they should invest, specific leads generated through online and primary research, competitive event listings etc.
* Pass on weekly developments, agenda updates and new potential leads to sales team
* Help develop commercially attractive conference topics and speaker line\-ups
* Support the creation of sponsorship opportunities aligned with program content
* Contribute to audience growth by inviting VIP delegates and speaker connections and overall event profitability


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong research and analytical skills

* Confidence engaging with senior executives and C\-level decision\-makers

* Excellent organizational and time management skills
* Commercial awareness and understanding of B2B conference models
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Proactive, adaptable, and solutions\-oriented mindset
* Strong networking, negotiation, and follow\-up skills


**Preferred Experience**

* Experience engaging with senior executives and international stakeholders

data.jd_text:
Location: Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Department: Championship Management
   

  

 Reports to: Senior Championship Manager
   

  

**Who We Are**
 The European Tour group administers golf’s global Tour \- the DP World Tour \- the HotelPlanner Tour and the Staysure Legends Tour, as well as golf’s greatest team contest, the Ryder Cup.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a Championship Manager to join our Championship Management team, based in our Dubai office.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, delivery\-focused role at the heart of our global events programme. You’ll work closely with Championship Management and event\-specific teams to plan, project manage and deliver world\-class events across our Tours.
   

  

 You’ll support the Championship Management Team on Tier 1 events and take the lead on Tier 2 and Tier 3 events, working under the guidance of the Championship Director.
   

  

 While the role is predominantly Middle East–based, there will be opportunities to work in Europe and Asia, including periods of travel of up to four weeks at a time, with weekend and evening working required around event delivery.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast\-paced, international environment and enjoy taking ownership of complex events from concept to delivery, this role offers real scope and challenge.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Event planning \& delivery
   

  

* Work with internal and external stakeholders to understand event requirements, build delivery plans and execute them effectively
* Produce detailed event proposals, including timelines, venues, suppliers, staffing, budgets and legal obligations
* Lead all pre\-event planning activity for assigned events
* Run day\-to\-day operations for Tier 2 and Tier 3 events
* Support the Senior Championship Manager in creating and delivering operational plans for Tier 1 events


 Supplier \& stakeholder management

**Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on\-demand food and Q\-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat's local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.**
**We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily. Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000\+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.**
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
**The Manager – Partner Product is a leadership role within the Central Digital Transformation team. You will act as the single\-threaded owner for building, upgrading, and reviewing the implementation and impact of all Partner\-facing products and digital processes.**
**The primary focus of this role is to maximize the self\-service ratio and significantly Save Account Manager (AM) time for our Food and Local Shop partners. You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of product solutions that automate manual touchpoints and enhance the digital capabilities of the partner portal. By bridging the gap between technical product features and operational efficiency, you will ensure our partners can manage and grow their businesses independently.**
**Our Leadership Principles**
**To succeed in this role, you must embody the following talabat leadership values:**
* Own It: Responsible for the results of the team and the standards under which they operate.
* Deep Dive: Fosters a culture of curiosity and problem solving by utilizing data from various perspectives.
* Deliver Value Fast: Drives a sense of urgency in the team to meet objectives, moving quickly and prioritizing based on impact.
* Bring Good Vibes: Fosters optimism and resilience in the team to face challenges and achieve goals.
* Raise the Bar: Sets ambitious goals and builds high\-performance teams through coaching, development, and constant feedback.
* Stay Humble: Admits mistakes and leverages diverse perspectives to challenge the status quo and generate innovative solutions.


**What’s On Your Plate?**
**Product Automation \& Self\-Service Strategy**
* Self\-Service Ratio Expansion: Work closely with the central Product team to recommend and implement improvements to Partner\-facing features that drive a higher self\-serve ratio.
* Reduce AM Overhead: Identify and execute technical improvements to existing digital processes (such as order cancellations, refunds, and disputes) to reduce the volume of 1:1 manual contacts.
* Portal Optimization: Lead the digital experience of the Partner Portal, ensuring it remains the primary, intuitive hub for Food and Local Shop partners to manage their business independently.
* Feature Adoption: Support the roll\-out of new products and features aimed at improving business performance and operational efficiency across MENA.


**Experience \& Product Performance Management**
* North Star Metrics: Own the Self\-Service Ratio as the primary indicators of a successful, low\-friction partner experience.
* Product Performance Tracking: Monitor product performance and usage across MENA countries, providing management with regular reports and actionable insights.
* Data\-Driven Roadmap: Identify data\-backed insights to further efforts on scalable, automated initiatives, acting as a thought leader for the Partner Growth organization.


**Team Leadership \& Product Excellence**
* High\-Performance Coaching: Build a high\-performance team through coaching, development, and constant feedback.
* Resource Management: Manage team resources (budget, people) effectively to achieve automation goals.
* Stakeholder Interaction: Coordinate stakeholder meetings across regional sales, global teams, and talabat product/ops teams to ensure seamless alignment on the product roadmap.


**Qualifications**
**What Did We Order?**
* Experience: 7\+ years of program or project management experience.
* Industry Background: Prior work experience in an eCommerce, food\-tech, or consulting industry is highly preferred.
* Strategic Leadership: Experience owning program strategy, end\-to\-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership is a must.
* Technical Stack: Required proficiency in creating dashboards and visualizations using Tableau, Data Studio, and Looker.
* CRM Expertise: Experience with CRM data, including Salesforce, is required.
* Product Methodology: Deep understanding of product methodologies and demonstrated expertise in the on\-time delivery of project solutions with structured documentation.

**Project Overview** 




 This is a greenfield CCGT project to be constructed with a net power capacity of 2400 MW, together with its ancillary equipment, associated infrastructure and facilities. The Project comprises the Plant and associated Electrical Special Facilities (ESF). The Plant will be located inland at a site situated approximately 50 km north\-east of the City of Abu Dhabi.  
 



 This role offers a unique opportunity to engage in the full lifecycle of the project, from design and engineering to construction and operation, all within a dynamic and innovative environment. This project promises stability and long\-term impact. 
   





**Location** 




 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is approx. 30 kms to 40 kms from Abu Dhabi city).
   





**Duration** 




 Approx 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 Control the quality and procedures during the CCGT project execution.
   





**Duties \& Responsibilities** 



* Developing QA/QC procedure for the CCGT project execution as per the PPA and EPC Contract and ISO standards.
* Review of the quality document, MSRA, ITP, inspection checklist and procedures submitted by the EPC Contractor.
* Lead the QA/QC engineers to monitor \& inspect the EPC Contractor quality works for all the Civil works, Mechanical and Electrical as per the approved drawings and specifications.
* Highlighting quality related issues to the construction team and providing technical advice.
* Other tasks assigned by Project Manager/Director for the project schedule controls.

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent.
* 10\+ years of experience with at least 5 years with CCGT Power Plants.

* Good software knowledge and skills in MS Office.

* Strong leadership presence, interpersonal and communication skills to coordinate with EPC contractors, and internal departments.

data.jd_text:
**About Woods Bagot – Architecture for Worlds Ahead** 




 We design places that meet the challenges and opportunities of our rapidly changing world. Our commitment to exploration, impact and community creates enduring, forward‑thinking outcomes, unlocking humanity’s highest potential. With a global design culture devoted to creativity, resilience, and purpose – we ensure every project contributes to our client’s vision, inspiring future generations.
 



  





 Woods Bagot is part of the 7C Network. The 7C Network is an integrated network of design and architecture companies that provides “Total Place Design,” a holistic approach to creating transformative environments. It combines capabilities from its constituent brands – including Woods Bagot, ERA\-co, Impact Futures, and Customs Bureau – to offer services in placemaking, sustainability, architecture and interior design, and luxury concepts.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Project Leader to join our Dubai Studio and play a key role in the successful design and delivery of major projects across the Middle East and Europe. The successful candidate will initially lead a significant rail infrastructure project before transitioning to support and lead other key projects across our diverse portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Architect who enjoys working across complex, multidisciplinary environments and is motivated by designing and delivering high\-profile projects that shape cities and communities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of major projects from planning and design through to construction and completion.
* Initially provide leadership on a significant rail infrastructure project, ensuring successful delivery against programme, budget, and design objectives.
* Manage project resources, budgets, and risk throughout the project lifecycle.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including architecture, engineering, planning, urban design, and specialist consultants.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, design coordination, and project review meetings.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and project governance processes.
* Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve project challenges.
* Support business development activities and contribute to the pursuit of new project opportunities.
* Mentor and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing project environment.



  





**About You** 




 You are an experienced Architectural Project Leader with a proven ability to lead the design and delivery of complex, large\-scale projects. Combining strong design sensibility with effective project leadership, you are skilled at managing clients, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality architectural outcomes across all stages of a project's lifecycle.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* 15\+ years' experience designing and delivering complex architectural projects.
* Previous experience working on rail projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering large\-scale, design\-led projects with multiple stakeholders and complex coordination requirements.
* Experience working on transportation, rail, aviation, civic, mixed\-use, commercial, or other major development projects would be highly advantageous.
* Strong understanding of architectural project delivery, including design management, consultant coordination, project planning, and contract administration.
* Excellent design leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Degree qualification in Architecture; professional registration or chartership is desirable.
* Experience working within the UAE or broader Middle East region, with an understanding of local project delivery processes and regulatory requirements.
* A collaborative leadership style with a passion for mentoring, developing, and inspiring team members.
* Strong appreciation of design quality, technical excellence, and the delivery of innovative architectural solutions.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Applicants are required to submit a resume and portfolio via our Project Leader \- Rail LinkedIn Job Post. Due to file upload restrictions we recommend providing a link to your portfolio within your resume. Applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. We do not accept unsolicited resumes or names from agencies. All personal data collected by us will be kept confidential and only used for recruitment purposes.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement: It is an essential requirement that at the time of applying for this position, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UAE.** 




  





**7C \- Total Place Design Network** 




 7C is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status. At 7C, we are committed to creating an environment where difference is celebrated, valued and respected, practices are equitable, and our people feel like they belong. We accept that none of us is smarter than all of us. We believe building a diverse workforce is the foundation to creativity and innovative design – it is only by working together that we can realise the potential of our people, clients and communities around us. Through our inclusive leadership and our truly global studio network, you will find your voice and have the support and flexibility required to bring your whole self to work and build an exceptional career.

* Ensure Electrical and Mechanical installation teams maintain standards in accordance with the approved Method Statements, Technical Orders/Manuals and ISO Standards as applicable.
* Close coordination and oversight with Divisional Authorizing Engineer and site SAP’s / AP’s as applicable.
* Assist with ensuring that the quality management system (QMS) is fully implemented in an organized and efficient manner whilst working closely with related engineering, construction, fabrication and commissioning departments.
* Provide support as requested for Method Statement preparation and client presentations as required.
* Prepare overall Project Executive Summary Reports and attend weekly meetings as required for progress updates on projects

* Advancing quality achievement and performance improvement throughout the project

**Experience And Qualifications**
* Time served apprenticeship an advantage.
* Electrical, Mechanical, Instrumentation Engineer
* Minimum 15 years work experience on construction projects.
* Qualifications commensurate with position:
* Role applicable degree from a reputed university / Trade Qualifications NVQ, etc.
* Experience in Data Centre Projects min 5 years.
* Equipment category specific training
* LOTO Experience Responsible Person (REP)
* Competent in the use of PC applications (Microsoft Office suit or equivalent).

 **Project Manager**

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many futureproofing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, etc. DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of unlimited imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website:www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





  





  





**Life at Research, Development \& Innovation (RDI)** 




 Research, Development \& Innovation (RDI) is Dubai Future Foundation’s dedicated research arm, established to advance applied and frontier research that directly shapes Dubai’s innovation agenda. RDI will house multiple specialised research centers, each focused on distinct domains, creating a collaborative ecosystem where deep expertise converges to address the most complex challenges facing cities and societies of the future. Through strategic partnerships with leading academic institutions, global think tanks, and government entities, RDI translates emerging knowledge into actionable insights, policy recommendations, and real\-world impact at a local, regional, and global scale.
 



  





  





  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 This role bridges the gap between business needs and technology delivery, working hand\-in\-hand with the Head of Technology to translate strategic objectives into actionable system and process requirements. It is essential to ensuring that digital platforms, research tools, and innovation initiatives are designed around real user needs and organizational priorities.
 



  





**Business Analyst** 




 As the Business Analyst, you will work closely with the Head of Technology and cross\-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document business and system requirements that drive the development and optimization of technology solutions. You will serve as the critical link between stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that digital initiatives are aligned with RDI’s research, development, and innovation strategy.
 



 The Business Analyst will support the delivery of IT and data platforms by translating complex business challenges into clear functional specifications, process models, and system design recommendations.
 



  





  





  





**Your Responsibilities** 




 • You will collaborate closely with the Head of Technology to define and deliver technology solutions that support the research, development and innovation program strategy.
 



 • You will discover, document, and validate business and functional requirements from stakeholders across departments, ensuring clarity and alignment before development begins.
 



 • You will perform system analysis to assess current\-state processes and systems, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
 



 • You will produce detailed business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, process flow diagrams, and use cases.
 



 • You will support the delivery of digital projects such as the Trusted Research Environment (TRE), collaboration portals, CRM systems, and IP management platforms, ERP systems, etc.
 



 • You will explore and evaluate the application of agentic AI systems and data\-driven tools to enhance research workflows, automate routine processes, and unlock new analytical capabilities across RDI’s platforms.
 



 • You will manage requirements backlogs within infrastructure projects (Azure), ensuring traceability from business need to technical delivery.
 



 • You will conduct user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate with end users, and validate that delivered solutions meet defined requirements.
 



 • You will support data analysis and reporting needs, working with internal teams and external research partners , including academic institutions, global think tanks, and government entities, to define data structures, dashboards, and reporting frameworks, operating comfortably within RDI’s diverse partner ecosystem.
 



 • You will assist in the evaluation of third\-party vendors and platforms by documenting technical requirements and participating in RFP and assessment processes.
 



 • You will produce user guides, training materials, and SOPs to support adoption of new systems and processes across teams.
 



 • You will support organisational change management as new systems, platforms, and processes are introduced across RDI , including stakeholder communication, training coordination, adoption tracking, and feedback collection to ensure smooth transitions.
 



 • You will stay current on emerging technologies and best practices in business analysis, recommending process and system improvements to enable research excellence.
 



  





  





  





**Why this role is important?** 




 This role is central to ensuring that technology investments deliver real business value. By bridging stakeholder needs and IT delivery, the Business Analyst enables faster, more effective deployment of digital solutions that power RDI’s innovation and research agenda.
 



  





  





  





**What Dubai Future Foundation offers?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with people who are passionate about the future and establishing Dubai as one of the leading cities of the world. You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas, and innovation.
 



  





  





  





**Who We're Looking For?** 




 • You will have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
 



 • You will have a minimum of 1 \-2 years of experience in business analysis, with demonstrated ability to work on complex IT or digital transformation projects.
 



 • You will have experience working closely with IT teams and managers, translating technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.
 



 • You will have proficiency in Agile methodologies with hands\-on experience for backlog management and requirements tracking.
 



 • You will have strong skills in process modelling, requirements documentation, and use case development using tools. BPMN 2\.0 notation knowledge is a plus.
 



 • You will have experience with systems analysis, including current\-state assessment, gap analysis, and solution design , prior experience as a Systems Analyst is a strong plus.
