data.jd_text:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get to know our team**
 The People Team at Agoda is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent from across the globe. We work to create an inclusive, high\-performing, and engaging environment where employees can grow, contribute meaningfully, and do their best work. Through a strong focus on people experience, service quality, and business partnership, we help Agoda scale while preserving what makes our culture distinctive.
   

  

 Within the People Team, the
 **People Experience and Services** 
 function is responsible for designing and delivering critical people experiences, services, and operating foundations that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle. This includes enabling smooth onboarding and mobility experiences, delivering effective workplace and office services, and ensuring employees have access to timely, trusted, and high\-quality support when they need it.
   

  

 At the center of this model sits
 **People Services \& Help Desk** 
 — Agoda’s front door for People support — supported by specialist service teams such as
 **People Relations Services** 
 . Together, these teams play a critical role in how employees and managers experience the People function day to day: through clear guidance, responsive support, effective issue resolution, and trusted handling of sensitive people matters.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for an
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 to lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People service delivery model across
 **People Help Desk / Tier 1 support** 
 ,
 **Tier 0 / self\-service foundations** 
 , and
 **Global People Relations Services** 
 .
   

  

 This is a key leadership role within People Experience and Services, responsible for shaping how employees and managers access support across a wide range of People topics — from day\-to\-day HR questions and lifecycle support to more complex and sensitive employee matters requiring specialist intervention.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for:
   

  

* People Help Desk / Tier 1 services
* Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge foundations
* Global People Relations Services, including case governance and specialist support for complex employee relations matters


 You will own the effectiveness of Agoda’s People support model from the employee and manager perspective, ensuring it is clear, trusted, scalable, and increasingly insight\-driven. This includes strengthening service standards, improving routing and handoffs across teams, enabling greater self\-service, and ensuring sensitive employee matters are handled with appropriate quality, consistency, and governance.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a leader who combines strong service delivery and operational leadership with sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to build a modern, scalable People support model in a global, fast\-moving organization.
   

  

 This position is based in
 **Bangkok** 
 . Agoda provides relocation support for successful candidates who are not currently located in Bangkok. Please note that we are
 **not open to remote work** 
 or the possibility of being based in other locations.
   

  

**In this role, you’ll get to:**
* Lead Agoda’s People Services front door and employee support model
* Lead Agoda’s employee\-facing People Services model across Tier 1 Help Desk support, Tier 0 self\-service, and the interface into specialist support teams.
* Define and evolve how employees and managers access support across People topics, ensuring a clear, seamless, and trusted experience.
* Establish strong service principles, operating rhythms, and leadership across the teams responsible for day\-to\-day People support and complex employee issue resolution.
* Ensure Agoda’s People support model scales effectively with organizational growth, complexity, and global reach.
* Lead the People Services \& Help Desk team
* Lead, manage, and develop the People Services \& Help Desk team to deliver high\-quality, consistent, and empathetic Tier 1 support across core HR topics such as policies, processes, employee data, benefits, onboarding, leaves, mobility, and general employee lifecycle support.
* Set service standards, KPIs, quality expectations, and operating controls to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant case handling.
* Build a strong service culture with clear accountability for employee experience, right\-first\-time resolution, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and prioritization across service demand, seasonal peaks, and new People initiatives.
* Lead Global People Relations Services
* Lead the Global People Relations Services team, ensuring high\-quality and well\-governed support across complex employee matters such as performance concerns, misconduct, grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, involuntary exits, and employee matters arising from organizational change.
* Ensure clear service ownership, escalation pathways, and governance across People Relations case handling.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure people relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, pragmatically, and in line with internal policies and local legal requirements.
* Drive high standards in case management, documentation, risk identification, and decision quality across the People Relations team.
* Use case trends and themes to inform improvements in manager guidance, policy design, service processes, and broader practices.
* Own the operating interfaces across Tier 1, People Relations, and specialist teams
* Serve as the senior operational owner for how work flows between Help Desk / Tier 1, People Relations Services, and other Tier 2 / specialist teams across the People organization.
* Define and continuously improve routing logic, escalation models, intake criteria, handoffs, service ownership, and resolution pathways.
* Ensure employees and managers experience a joined\-up service model even when multiple People teams are involved.
* Clarify roles and interfaces across Help Desk, People Relations, Payroll, Rewards, Mobility, People Partners, CoEs, and other specialist teams.
* Build Tier 0 / self\-service and knowledge management foundations
* Develop and execute Agoda’s roadmap for Tier 0 / self\-service, moving the organization toward more proactive, intuitive, and self\-directed resolution of common People queries.
* Own and strengthen the People knowledge ecosystem, including FAQs, help content, decision trees, agent guidance, and employee\-facing support materials.
* Partner with policy owners and People SMEs to simplify complex topics into clear, scalable, and user\-friendly content.
* Drive case deflection, knowledge reuse, content governance, and self\-service adoption through disciplined measurement and continuous improvement.
* Enable digital, conversational, and AI\-supported service delivery
* Partner with Product, Tech, Systems, and Data teams to improve People support platforms, workflows, and user journeys across self\-service and case management.
* Identify and help shape practical use cases for conversational and agentic AI within People Services, ensuring they enhance employee experience and complement human support.
* Provide leadership input into the design, testing, rollout, and continuous refinement of AI\-enabled and digital service solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls, privacy, escalation paths, and trust mechanisms are in place for all digital and AI\-supported support channels.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement
* Monitor and improve key service performance metrics across Help Desk and People Relations Services, such as case volume, first contact resolution, time to resolution, service quality, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, re\-open rates, and self\-service deflection.
* Lead ongoing improvements in workflows, playbooks, standard responses, training, quality assurance, and reporting.
* Partner with People Service Excellence and other stakeholders to simplify processes, remove friction, and improve end\-to\-end employee and manager experiences.
* Ensure effective controls, compliance, documentation standards, and data privacy practices are embedded across service operations.
* Lead through insight, stakeholder partnership, and change
* Act as the senior People Services contact for service performance, priorities, risks, and transformation opportunities.
* Provide regular insight and reporting to People leaders on service trends, root causes, organizational pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Communications and relevant People teams to coordinate messaging around policy changes, process updates, and new tools or services.
* Support broader People transformation by bringing an employee\-service lens to operating model design, simplification, and capability building across the function.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Operations, Law, Psychology, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience across HR shared services, employee services, People operations, employee relations, HRBP, service delivery, or related functions, including significant leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and/or multiple service teams in a complex, matrixed, and fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience running a service or support function with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, service design, and stakeholder experience.
* Strong understanding of multi\-tier service delivery models, including Tier 0 / self\-service, Tier 1 support, and specialist / Tier 2 case management.
* Meaningful exposure to employee relations or complex people issue resolution, with sound judgment on sensitive matters and a strong appreciation for governance, risk, and consistency.
* Strong skills in service design, operating model improvement, process improvement, and cross\-functional workflow design.
* Experience with HR technology platforms and service tools such as HRIS, case management systems, knowledge bases, and digital support tools.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify themes and root causes, and drive prioritization and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across leaders, specialist teams, and cross\-functional partners.
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching leaders and managers, building team capability, and creating a high\-performance, service\-oriented culture.
* Comfort operating in a global, evolving, and ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for execution, improvement, and scale.


**It’s great if you also have**
* Experience in a global or regional HR shared services / People services environment.
* Experience leading both broad employee support teams and specialist employee relations or case management teams.
* Experience in knowledge management, service content strategy, and self\-service adoption.
* Hands\-on exposure to conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or workflow automation in HR or customer support environments.
* Experience improving employee experience through service redesign, process simplification, or digital product thinking.
* Experience in a high\-growth tech, internet, or digital business.
* Familiarity with global organizations operating across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.


**Why this role matters**
 This role is a unique opportunity to shape how Agoda employees and managers experience People support at scale. From everyday HR queries to more complex and sensitive employee matters, the teams in this scope play an important role in making sure our people feel supported, informed, and able to navigate key moments in their Agoda journey with confidence.
   

  

 As
 **Associate Director, Head of People Services \& Help Desk** 
 , you will help build a more connected, scalable, and future\-ready support model, improving service quality, strengthening self\-service, and ensuring complex cases are handled with care and consistency. Your work will directly influence employee experience, manager effectiveness, and how the People function continues to evolve as Agoda grows globally.
   

  

 \#PeopleServices \#HRSharedServices \#EmployeeRelations \#Bangkok \#Singapore \#Bengaluru \#Hyderabad \#NewDelhi \#Gurugram \#Noida \#Mumbai \#Pune \#Chennai \#Jakarta \#Manila \#KualaLumpur \#HoChiMinhCity \#Hanoi \#HongKong \#Taipei \#Seoul \#Dubai \#Istanbul
   

  

 Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

* Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
* Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/

 At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. **About Yellow Door Energy**
 Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa.
   

  

 We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability and lower carbon emissions. Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy and energy efficiency.
   

  

 Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui \& Co, TAEF and the International Finance Corporation.
   

  

 🔍 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for an
 **Assistant Manager \- Client \& Commercial Asset Management** 
 to support the post\-commissioning management of Yellow Door Energy’s operational asset portfolio in the UAE.
   

  

 This is an
 **HQ\-based, commercially focused, client\-facing role** 
 sitting at the intersection of
 **customer relationship management, commercial coordination, contractual follow\-up, asset performance tracking and internal stakeholder management** 
 .
   

  

 You will act as a key point of contact for assigned customers after commissioning, helping ensure that customer queries are handled professionally,
 **billing and receivables matters are followed up, asset performance updates are coordinated, and internal teams remain aligned on actions, timelines and responsibilities** 
 .
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Asset Management, you will work closely with customers, O\&M, Finance, Legal, Insurance and senior management to support strong client satisfaction, contractual compliance, portfolio performance and long\-term asset value.
   

  

 This role is best suited to someone with experience in
 **client relationship management, aftersales, commercial operations, service delivery coordination, contract management or asset management** 
 within renewable energy, infrastructure, utilities, facilities management or another asset\-intensive environment.
   

  

 ⚡ What You’ll Deliver \& Own
   

  

 In this role, you will support the successful
 **commercial management** 
 of YDE’s operational assets after commissioning, ensuring customer relationships, contractual obligations, asset performance updates and internal coordination are managed effectively.
   

  

**You Will**
* Act as the main point of contact for assigned customers post\-commissioning, supporting strong relationships, timely communication and issue resolution.
* Coordinate customer\-related matters, including billing queries, receivables follow\-up, customer securities, invoicing support and contractual obligations.
* Track asset performance, generation performance, operational events, downtime and incidents with potential commercial, contractual or customer impact.
* Work closely with O\&M and technical teams to understand asset performance issues, resolution plans, timelines and customer updates.
* Coordinate with Finance on receivables, billing status, payment follow\-ups, budget versus actual updates and financial reporting inputs.
* Support lender reporting and compliance for financed assets, including DSCR calculations, covenant tracking, debt service obligations, insurance requirements and reporting deadlines.
* Prepare and coordinate portfolio reports, customer updates, receivables summaries, asset summaries and compliance submissions.
* Work cross\-functionally with Finance, Legal, Insurance, O\&M, technical teams and senior management to resolve matters impacting customers, asset performance or contractual compliance.
* Identify commercial risks, customer concerns and value enhancement opportunities across the portfolio, including optimisation initiatives, expansions or customer growth opportunities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of client management, reporting, internal coordination and ways of working.


 🛠️ What You Must Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–7 years of experience in client relationship management, account management, aftersales, commercial operations, service delivery coordination, contract management, asset management or a similar commercially focused role.
* Experience working in renewable energy, infrastructure, utilities, facilities management, engineering services, energy services or another asset\-intensive environment.
* Strong customer and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage expectations, follow up on actions and coordinate across multiple teams.
* Commercial awareness, with the ability to understand billing, receivables, contractual obligations, performance issues and risk.
* Experience working with long\-term customer contracts, service agreements, leases, PPAs, infrastructure agreements or similar commercial arrangements.
* Strong Excel, reporting and coordination capability.
* Ability to manage multiple customers, assets, priorities and time\-sensitive stakeholder requirements.
* Clear, professional communication skills and confidence working with both internal and external stakeholders.


 Strong Advantage
   

  

* Experience with solar PV, distributed energy, C\&I infrastructure or energy\-as\-a\-service business models.
* Exposure to O\&M coordination, technical service delivery, post\-commissioning customer support or asset performance follow\-up.
* Experience supporting financed assets, lender reporting, covenant compliance or DSCR calculations.
* Experience coordinating across Finance, Legal, O\&M, technical, insurance and commercial teams.
* Working understanding of generation performance, asset performance drivers, downtime, deemed energy or customer\-facing performance issues.
* Experience preparing customer updates, portfolio reports, receivables analysis, compliance submissions or asset performance summaries.


 You’ll Thrive Here If...
   

  

 You are likely to succeed in this role if you enjoy being close to the commercial and operational performance of assets, and you are comfortable acting as a trusted coordination point between customers, lenders and internal teams.
   

  

**You Will Thrive Here If You**
* Build trusted relationships with customers and stakeholders.
* Enjoy being the coordination point between clients, O\&M, finance, legal and commercial teams.
* Are commercially aware and able to spot risks, obligations and opportunities early.
* Can follow up firmly and professionally on billing, receivables, customer issues and internal actions.
* Communicate clearly, especially when managing issues, escalations or competing priorities.
* Stay calm and structured when handling multiple customers, assets and deadlines.
* Can interpret contracts, financial information and operational updates with strong attention to detail.
* Think like an asset owner and take accountability for outcomes.
* Care about sustainability and want to contribute to the growth of clean energy across the region.


 🌱 Why Join Us?
   

  

 At Yellow Door Energy, you’ll be part of a leading sustainable energy company delivering real impact across the Middle East and Africa.
   

  

 You’ll work with experienced professionals across renewable energy, finance, asset management, engineering and operations, supporting assets that help businesses reduce energy costs, improve reliability and lower carbon emissions.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to build your career in renewable energy asset management while contributing to a mission\-led business focused on sustainable growth, customer impact and long\-term value creation.
   

  

 📩 Apply Now
   

  

 If you are an asset management professional with experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, utilities or operational asset environments, and you are ready to help manage a growing clean energy portfolio, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Let’s lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.

data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a leading international consumer organisation undergoing a significant phase of operational evolution and regional transformation across Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia.
 



  





 This appointment represents a strategically critical leadership hire, responsible for shaping and embedding a future\-ready operational model capable of supporting long\-term regional growth, scalability, efficiency, and commercial agility across diverse and evolving markets.
 



  





 Operating at Executive Committee level, the role will lead the transition and centralisation of key operational capabilities into Dubai, redefining how the organisation structures, governs, and executes operations across the region.
 



  





 This is not a traditional supply chain leadership position. It is a broad operational transformation mandate focused on organisational design, operating model evolution, infrastructure optimisation, and cross\-functional integration across complex international markets.
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



  





 The Director of Operational Transformation will be responsible for architecting and executing a large\-scale operational transformation agenda across MEA \& Asia.
 



 The successful individual will act as a strategic partner to regional and global leadership, driving the redesign of operational frameworks, improving organisational capability, enhancing supply network effectiveness, and establishing scalable infrastructure aligned with the organisation’s long\-term ambitions.
 



 The role requires a leader capable of balancing strategic vision with operational execution, while operating effectively across both mature and emerging markets.
 



 This individual will play a central role in influencing how the organisation evolves operationally over the coming years.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Strategic Operational Transformation
 


* Define and execute a regional operational transformation roadmap aligned with business growth objectives and long\-term organisational priorities
* Lead the redesign and optimisation of the regional operating model across operational functions
* Drive the transition and centralisation of operational capabilities into Dubai, ensuring effective governance, scalability, and regional alignment
* Partner closely with Executive Committee stakeholders to shape strategic operational priorities and long\-term capability development
* Evaluate current operational structures, identify inefficiencies, and implement future\-focused solutions to enhance agility and performance



 Operating Model \& Infrastructure Development
 


* Design scalable operational frameworks capable of supporting multi\-market growth across MEA \& Asia
* Establish governance structures, decision\-making frameworks, and operational standards across regional markets
* Develop integrated operational ecosystems connecting planning, logistics, procurement, distribution, customer operations, and commercial functions
* Support the evolution of regional hub structures, shared service capabilities, and centralised operational functions
* Lead organisational alignment initiatives to ensure operational structures support both regional and local market needs



 Supply Chain, Logistics \& Distribution Transformation
 


* Oversee the transformation and optimisation of regional supply chain and distribution networks
* Drive operational excellence initiatives across warehousing, transportation, inventory management, and fulfilment operations
* Evaluate and redesign logistics infrastructure and 3PL operating models to improve service levels, responsiveness, and cost efficiency
* Establish operational KPI frameworks to monitor service performance, operational efficiency, and network effectiveness
* Drive automation and digital enablement initiatives to improve operational visibility, planning capability, and execution consistency



 Procurement, Partnerships \& External Ecosystems
 


* Lead the development of strategic operational partnerships across logistics, distribution, manufacturing, and external service providers
* Oversee supplier and partner governance frameworks to ensure accountability, scalability, and performance delivery
* Support procurement transformation initiatives focused on cost optimisation, operational resilience, and strategic sourcing capability
* Negotiate and manage complex operational and commercial agreements with regional and global partners



 Transformation Delivery \& Change Leadership
 


* Lead complex, cross\-functional transformation programmes across multiple geographies and stakeholder groups
* Drive adoption of new operational processes, technologies, governance models, and organisational structures
* Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Coach and develop regional operational leadership teams to strengthen organisational capability and succession planning
* Act as a visible transformation leader capable of influencing senior stakeholders across regional and global functions



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate will bring significant experience leading operational transformation, operating model redesign, and regional operational leadership within complex multinational environments.
 



 Candidates will typically come from leading FMCG, consumer goods, beauty, retail, or similarly sophisticated international organisations.
 



 Experience \& Background
 


* Proven experience leading large\-scale operational transformation initiatives across international markets
* Strong operational leadership background spanning supply chain, logistics, procurement, planning, distribution, and operational governance
* Demonstrated experience designing or evolving regional operating models and organisational structures
* Experience leading regional hub centralisation, shared services transformation, or cross\-border operational migration projects
* Strong understanding of operational infrastructure, supply network optimisation, and multi\-market operational complexity
* Experience operating within matrix organisations and engaging with Executive Committee or Board\-level stakeholders
* Strong commercial understanding with the ability to align operational strategy to broader business objectives



 Leadership Capabilities
 


* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into executable operational frameworks
* Highly credible stakeholder manager with strong influencing and communication capabilities
* Commercially astute with a balanced understanding of growth, efficiency, and operational sustainability
* Comfortable operating in complex, evolving, and high\-growth environments
* Strong organisational leadership capability with experience developing high\-performing regional teams
* Resilient, adaptable, and capable of leading transformation through ambiguity and organisational change

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 The Platform Owner — Cards is accountable for the end‑to‑end run and change lifecycle of RAKBANK’s cards technology platforms, including TSYS Prime 4, TSYS Online Authorization, and post‑facto fraud systems, managing them as a strategic internal bank product. The role ensures platform stability, availability, fraud effectiveness, and API‑driven capability exposure in a millisecond‑critical, scheme‑governed environment, while driving continuous evolution to support new card products, digital wallets, tokenisation, contactless payments, and UAE local and international scheme mandates. Acting as the bank’s primary IT authority for cards, the Platform Owner leads specialist engineering and BA teams and represents the platform in business, scheme, and regulatory engagements, balancing operational excellence with forward‑looking innovation to meet the needs of Personal, SME, Commercial, and Corporate banking segments.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Own the full run‑and‑change lifecycle of RAKBANK’s cards platforms (TSYS Prime 4, Online Authorization, post‑facto fraud), managing them as strategic internal products with defined SLOs, SLAs, and uptime KPIs.
* Ensure full compliance with UAE local payment scheme mandates alongside Visa and Mastercard requirements, managing certifications, timelines, and regulatory obligations.
* Drive platform innovation and future readiness to support new card products, digital wallets, tokenisation, BNPL, and emerging payment capabilities at scale.
* Deliver platform capabilities that meet the full needs of Personal, SME, Commercial, and Corporate banking segments, translating business requirements into robust technology solutions.
* Govern and expose cards capabilities through stable, well‑documented APIs, ensuring versioning discipline and protection for consuming channels and squads.
* Lead high‑precision platform operations, including real‑time authorisation health, BCP/DR readiness, major incident management, and root‑cause elimination.
* Oversee post‑facto fraud detection effectiveness, including rule tuning, performance metrics, and alignment with evolving UAE and regional fraud patterns.
* Manage all platform run activities, including patching, releases, PCI DSS compliance, infrastructure coordination, and scheme certification continuity.
* Lead and develop a high‑performance cards platform team with clear ownership, accountability, and continuous capability building.
* Own and report all run‑and‑change KPIs, technical roadmap, and operational efficiency initiatives, ensuring platform readiness ahead of business and programme demand.



**What You Will Bring:** 



* 15\+ years in banking technology with at least 5 years in a platform management, product ownership, or senior application management role covering card management systems.
* Hands\-on experience with TSYS Prime 4 (or an equivalent enterprise card management platform such as OpenWay WAY4, Compass Plus, or FIS CAMS) is strongly preferred; direct TSYS Prime 4 experience is a significant advantage.
* Deep functional knowledge of card products and operations across the full customer spectrum — consumer credit and debit, prepaid and virtual cards, SME business cards, commercial and large corporate card programmes — and the platform configuration required to support each segment.
* Proven experience managing UAE local payment scheme obligations and mandate delivery — familiarity with Al Etihad Payments, UAESWITCH domestic scheme requirements, and the interoperability framework governing card transactions within the UAE, alongside Visa and Mastercard international scheme management.
* Strong understanding of digital payments innovation — digital wallet integration (Apple Pay, Google Pay), EMV tokenisation, contactless payments, 3DS authentication, open banking card APIs, and BNPL integration.
* Experience managing the post\-facto fraud detection capability — including rule management, fraud analytics, detection effectiveness optimisation, and coordination with fraud operations teams.
* Strong understanding of PCI DSS requirements and their operational implications for card platform management and scheme certification.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Prior experience in the same domain or hands\-on familiarity with the specific technologies relevant to this role will be considered a significant advantage during candidate evaluation.



**Desired Competencies:** 



* Cards platform ownership — TSYS Prime 4, authorisation, and fraud detection lifecycle
* UAE local scheme mandate management alongside Visa and Mastercard obligations
* Cards innovation — digital wallets, tokenisation, virtual cards, and segment\-specific product capability
* Multi\-segment cards domain expertise — personal banking, SME, commercial, and large corporate
* Real\-time authorisation platform operations and SLA/SLO governance
* PCI DSS compliance and scheme certification management
* API governance and stable cards platform interface design
* People leadership and cards technology team development

We're partnering with a rapidly scaling technology business that is transforming one of the region's largest and most complex industries through AI, automation, and data\-driven innovation.
 



  





 Backed by a well\-established regional group and operating with the agility of a startup, the company is building next\-generation products that are redefining how businesses and customers interact across a highly transactional environment.
 



  





 As part of its next phase of growth, the company is seeking an exceptional Head of Engineering to lead the technology function, shape engineering culture, and drive the execution of an ambitious AI\-powered product roadmap.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity for a hands\-on engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, product, and business.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the executive leadership team, you will take ownership of engineering strategy, team development, architecture, delivery excellence, and AI innovation. You will inherit a capable team and be responsible for elevating engineering standards, improving delivery velocity, and building a world\-class technology organization capable of scaling across the region.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems through technology, has experience building and scaling high\-performing engineering teams, and remains deeply involved in technical decision\-making.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Define and execute the company's engineering vision and technical strategy.
* Lead, mentor, and scale a multi\-disciplinary engineering team across multiple locations.
* Drive engineering excellence, delivery quality, and operational effectiveness across all products and platforms.
* Establish modern software development practices, CI/CD processes, testing frameworks, monitoring, and observability standards.
* Partner closely with Product and Design leadership to deliver customer\-centric solutions and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend, AI, and data platforms.
* Build and mature AI and automation capabilities, including agentic AI systems and intelligent workflow automation.
* Improve engineering productivity, release cadence, system reliability, and security posture.
* Develop strong technical leadership within the organization through coaching, succession planning, and selective hiring.
* Act as the senior technical voice within the leadership team, providing guidance on technology investments, risk management, scalability, and innovation.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years leading engineering teams.
* Previous experience as a Head of Engineering, VP Engineering, CTO, Co\-Founder, or equivalent senior technology leadership role.
* Proven track record of scaling engineering organizations in high\-growth startup, scale\-up, or technology\-driven environments.
* Strong hands\-on technical background with the ability to review architecture, contribute to technical discussions, and guide engineering direction.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across product, design, engineering, and data functions.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, cloud technologies, distributed systems, and engineering best practices.
* Experience building products in fast\-paced environments where reliability, speed, and customer experience are critical.
* Demonstrated success improving software delivery processes, engineering culture, and operational maturity.



  





 Highly Desirable
 


* Production experience with AI\-powered products, LLM applications, agentic AI systems, or intelligent automation platforms.
* Experience working within SaaS, platform businesses, marketplaces, CRM ecosystems, or transaction\-heavy environments.
* Exposure to data infrastructure, analytics platforms, and AI\-driven product development.
* Startup founder or early\-stage leadership experience.
* Experience managing distributed engineering teams.



  





 Why Join?
 


* Opportunity to shape the future of a high\-growth technology business with significant market impact.
* Direct access to executive leadership and strategic decision\-making.
* Significant ownership, influence, and autonomy.
* Meaningful equity participation.
* Well\-funded environment with long\-term growth ambitions.
* Opportunity to build industry\-leading AI products and engineering capabilities.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with the pace and excitement of a startup.



  





 This is a career\-defining opportunity for a technology leader who wants to build, scale, and leave a lasting impact on a business undergoing significant transformation.
 



  





 Location: Dubai, UAE (Onsite)
 



  





 Candidates currently based in the UAE will be highly preferred.

data.jd_text:
The role holder is responsible for managing the FM operations and maintenance activities in accordance with defined DHAM FM standards and processes with the objective of enhancing customer satisfaction, minimizing customer complaints, and maximizing revenue and profitability of the respective DHAM entity.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**Support with Budgeting** 



* Assist the department head in the preparation of annual operation and capital budgets.
* Monitor budget and highlight budget variances to ensure cost efficiencies in line with the scorecard for OPEX saving and
* Execution of approved CAPEX project in a timely manner.



**FM Operations** 



* Manage the team of FM Executive and FM Service Provider team for smooth daily FM operations.
* Monitor of FM Service Provider in delivery of services including Soft Services (Cleaning, Pest Control, Landscaping waste management etc.) and hard services (including reactive and preventive maintenance, as well all specialized services for critical and non\-critical equipment and ensure work is carried out as per agreed SLA and prepare snag reports.
* Supervise activities within the assigned community/asset, conduct regular meetings with internal \& external teams to monitor progress of FM activities and to ensure compliance with the agreed standards and requirements.
* Conduct regular site visits and promptly address identified issues.
* Responsible and manages DHAM CAFM system (Maximo) and its utilization on respective site.
* Monitor and maintain records of utilities expenditure and implement initiatives of sustainability and utilities cost saving projects.
* Represent the business unit during design, planning, construction, and handover stages of the newly developed assets to oversee FM requirements.
* Oversee activities directly related to regulatory requirements of life safety systems and ensure necessary certifications are obtained on time.
* Assist the fit\-out activities in DHAM’s assets to ensure compliance with the scope of work, HSE requirements and building’s standards.
* Assist business partners and their contractors with details on the requirements related to technical aspects, FM issues, fit\-out process and issue the necessary permits.
* Ensure FM records are created and maintained for all assigned sites such as site logbooks to demonstrate full operational procedures are followed.
* Ensure effective use of CAFM to ensure all Service Requests and Work Orders are tracked for timely completion in line with SLA requirements.
* Ensure new DHAM assets being brought into operations are entered onto pre\-planned maintenance program and subject to QA procedures.
* Planning future enhancement requirements by forecasting the facility’s upcoming needs and requirements.
* Identify gaps and deficiencies in services, advice, and effect solutions as part of Continuous Improvement on FM services rendered.
* Explore and recommend innovative methods, based on best practices, in order to bring about cost\-effective solutions.
* Writes and provides monthly operational and technical reports.



**Tendering \& Procurement** 



* Prepare SOW documents for FM operational services for new buildings and conduct necessary technical evaluation of the submitted proposals.
* Prepare scope of work for (operational variables and capex projects).
* Initiate procurement process, liaise with procurement department during the tendering process, review vendor responses and issue GRNs.
* Recommend procurement of appropriate supplies and equipment according to the operational needs.



**Vendor Management** 



* Ensure the service provider attends to all re\-active service requests from various stakeholders and in compliant with the agreed SLAs.
* Monitor SLAs and KPIs of the outsourced contractors and track performance levels of the contractor providing soft services against set KPIs and SLAs by routinely assessing performance.
* Maintain effective communication with suppliers, business departments and clients and provide active support in the delivery of services by suppliers as per SLAs and QHSE standards.
* Review and certify service provider’s monthly performance and payment certificate.
* Ensures that Service providers use DHAM CAFM systems for all service requests.



**Customer Complaint Management** 



* Ensure customer complaints are timely and appropriately managed and closed to achieve organization’s customer satisfaction targets.
* Ensure that Voice of Customer scores are meeting the minimum required for the FM Department.



**Cross Functional Coordination** 



* Conduct monthly meetings with FM service provider, HSE, security, and contractors to assess the contractor’s performance, HSE requirements, identify non\-compliance and action plans.
* Support the business development team in timely resolution of their queries related to facilities management in coordination with applicable internal departments.
* Manage project’s takeover from asset development and conduct necessary inspection, witness testing \& commissioning and manage rectification of defects and snags during the DLP in coordination with Asset Development Team and contractor.



**Continual Improvement** 



* Identify and recommend to the business unit and department head major improvements (technical and feel \& look) required to enhance the existing facilities.
* Contribute to the process of identifying facilities management best practices and development of formal processes and practices as necessary towards integrating and embedding sustainable principles and strategies into daily operational practices.
* Drive improvement in water and electricity saving and sustainability initiatives.



  





  





 Minimum Qualification:
 



  




* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Facilities Management.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* A professional qualification in real estate and / or facilities management (IWFM) or equivalent is desirable.



 Experience:
 


* Minimum 7\-9 years’ experience in a facilities management related role in a similar organization.



  





 Technical Competencies
 



  




* Demonstrable knowledge of the full spectrum of facilities management functions, including hard and soft services, contract management, tendering, business development etc.
* Maintain a calm demeanor with the ability to remain un\-flustered and maintain a cool head in different situations.
* Excellent negotiation and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with colleagues, contractors and key stakeholders.
* Excellent knowledge of maintenance and operations management.
* Knowledge of Health and Safety standards is advantageous.
* Demonstrate a full understanding of statutory legislation as it relates to the built environment.
* Ability to find pragmatic solutions and adapt to changing situations.
* Excellent communication skills. Arabic is advantageous.

data.jd_text:
**About Us:**




 Network International is the largest Financial Technology company in the Middle East and Africa. Payments is our core business where we provide services in more than 50 countries – UAE, Jordan, South Africa, Egypt are some of our key markets. Apart from payments, we provide services on Data and Insights, Lending, Insurance, Risk Solutions, etc. Our core customers are businesses at every scale and segment, though recently we have been growing in the direct\-to\-consumer card segment as well.
 



  





**Our EVP:**




 At Network International, we always stay ahead. . In the fast\-paced world of financial services, we thrive on innovation, agility, and purposeful collaboration. We invest first in our people, empowering you to make bold decisions, learn fast, and grow your expertise alongside industry leaders. Here, solving complex problems means more than using cutting\-edge technology; it’s about creating meaningful value for our customers, together. We foster a culture where trust, accountability, and achievement go hand in hand—because success isn’t just a goal; it’s how we work, every day, as one team.
 



  





**About the Role:**




 The role is responsible for leading Information Services across the organization, ensuring reliable delivery, governance, and enablement of data for internal stakeholders and platforms. This includes ownership of data infrastructure, data provisioning, and internal data products that power reporting, analytics, AI initiatives, and operational use cases.
 



  





 The role will drive the development and management of enterprise data capabilities including data lake infrastructure, data taxonomy, data quality, and access governance. The successful candidate will partner with cross\-functional teams (Finance, Sales, CRM, Risk, Product, and Technology) to ensure consistent, scalable, and secure data availability across the organization.
 



  





 The role requires a strong mix of data platform expertise, governance discipline, and stakeholder management, with a focus on enabling business teams through high\-quality, accessible, and well\-structured data assets.
 



**Working Conditions:**



* Primarily office\-based with occasional travel required for meetings, conferences, and training sessions.
* Fast\-paced and dynamic work environment.



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Own and manage internal data products and platforms, ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure data availability for business use cases.
* Lead development and management of enterprise data infrastructure, including global data lake capabilities and core data architecture.
* Oversee major data programs and transformations, including platform migrations and data architecture evolution.
* Ensure timely and accurate data provisioning to key business functions (Finance, Sales, CRM, cross\-sell, and internal applications), with clear SLA adherence.
* Define and enforce data governance standards, including data quality, taxonomy, master data (KYC/KYB), and access control frameworks.
* Enable analytics, AI, and automation use cases through structured and high\-quality data pipelines.
* Own internal BI and reporting capabilities, including dashboards and analytical tools (e.g., Qlik).
* Manage enterprise data access, compliance, and audit requirements, ensuring traceability and regulatory alignment.
* Oversee data platforms, tools, vendors, and software licensing, ensuring performance and cost efficiency.
* Drive development of unified data layers and internal data services to enable consistent access across the organization.
* Support data enrichment initiatives and advanced analytics use cases (e.g., churn, lead generation) aligned with enterprise data standards.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives such as company\-wide data intelligence capabilities (e.g., “Talk to Data”).



  





**Qualifications
 
 :** 



* Minimum 15 years of experience in data platforms, data engineering, and analytics, with end\-to\-end ownership of data products and infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in enterprise data architecture, including data lakes, data warehousing, and large\-scale data platform management.
* Proven experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data quality, taxonomy, master data (e.g., KYC/KYB), and access controls.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver data solutions for internal stakeholders, including Finance reporting, CRM, Sales dashboards, and operational platforms.
* Experience supporting AI, analytics, and automation initiatives through structured data environments and scalable data pipelines.
* Track record of managing complex data transformation programs, including platform migrations and cross\-regional implementations.
* Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools (e.g., Qlik, Power BI), with oversight of internal dashboards and analytical solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across Technology, Finance, Sales, Risk, and Product teams.
* Experience managing data platforms, vendors, and software licensing, ensuring performance and cost control.
* Proven leadership experience managing teams across geographies, with clear focus on delivery discipline and execution.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast\-paced environment, with clear prioritization across multiple initiatives.

**NOW HIRING AN ASSOCIATE HSEQ DIRECTOR** 




  





 Our client is a leading Real Estate Developer in Dubai
 



  





**The Position** 




 The position of Associate HSEQ Director will report to the Head of Delivery and be responsible for leading all HSEQ activities across a portfolio of projects from initiation through to handover and delivery completion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the implementation of QHSE strategies across the projects portfolio, ensuring alignment with delivery programmes, construction milestones, and operational readiness requirements.
* Drive health, safety, environmental and quality compliance across multiple sites, ensuring adherence to UAE regulations, client requirements, and international standards.
* Embed a strong safety and quality culture across contractors, consultants, and delivery teams, ensuring proactive risk identification and mitigation.
* Oversee contractor and site QHSE performance, including audits, inspections, monitoring, and enforcement of compliance standards.
* Ensure full compliance with UAE regulatory requirements, environmental obligations, and relevant ISO standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001\).
* Collaborate closely with project directors, construction teams, consultants, and delivery stakeholders to integrate QHSE into all phases of project execution.
* Lead incident investigation processes, root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor, analyse, and report on QHSE performance metrics across all projects, driving continuous improvement and best practice adoption.
* Support project completion, commissioning, and handover phases, ensuring all QHSE requirements are met prior to delivery.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate risks relating to safety, environmental impact, and quality throughout the project lifecycle.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 15\+ years of experience, including 3\+ years in a senior management QHSE role.
* Experience working with leading developers or consultants
* Strong background delivering HSEQ on large\-scale build projects
* Strong understanding of UAE health, safety, environmental, and construction regulatory frameworks.
* Extensive experience managing QHSE across major projects from construction through to handover.
* Strong knowledge of ISO management systems (9001, 14001, 45001\) and their application on live projects.
* Proven ability to manage contractor performance and drive compliance across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across delivery teams and senior project stakeholders.
* Hands\-on, delivery\-focused mindset with the ability to operate in a fast\-paced project environment.

The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

The person will work closely with CRO/HEAD GRCI, implementing Enterprise Risk Management Framework focusing on Tier 1 \& 2 risk reporting i.e. Strategic, Operational, Projects \& Investment Risks. The person shall also assist the CRO / HEAD in other strategic initiatives. The person shall coordinate with other functional areas in the Company to ensure all risks in the Company are identified, measured, mitigated/managed, and monitored/reported. On top of that, the person shall ensure insurance adequacy and address all queries on all lines of insurances promptly.

* Lead the end\-to\-end risk management process in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI, including identifying, quantifying, mitigating, and monitoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, project and investment risks).

This also includes ESG \& ABC risk identification and mitigation, implementation of appropriate risk management systems and loss event database are properly identified, quantified, managed and monitored.
* Partner and collaborate with other Line of Defence including Group Legal \& Advisory Services (GLAS), Group Clinical (GC), Internal Audit Services (IAS), Compliance \& Integrity Unit within GRCI and Group Sustainability Services (GSS) to to drive implementation of integrated risk management framework.
* Key activities include:
* Regularly updating and monitoring high\-risk medical malpractice active cases and sentinel events at hospitals that could result in viral or reputational damage.

* Collaborating with the Compliance and Integrity Unit to identify and address top risks and emerging ABC (Anti\-Bribery and Corruption) risks effectively.
* Ensuring the adoption and integration of appropriate risk management systems and maintaining a comprehensive loss event database for enhanced risk visibility and mitigation.
* To review and provide an independent assessment view on the key risks associated with projects \& investment undertaken with focus on Investment Risks.
* To review and challenge the proposals submitted by Hospitals or Subsidiaries on investment of new towers, renovations, major acquisition of assets and divestments by assessing their assumptions, investment costs, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, stress testing to evaluate the project resilience under various market conditions.
* Be the subject matter expert and change agent on ERM.
* Review the key risks associated with proposed major investments and projects (M\&As).
* Perform horizon scanning to identify emerging risks which may impact the organisation arising from changes in the external environment.
* Highlight emerging risks through flash report and emerging risk updates.
* Drive and champion risk initiatives/ innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning and advanced analytics.
* leveraging analytics, machine learning and automation.
* Champion innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics.
* Use advanced analytics and predictive modeling to anticipate risks, especially for high\-impact areas like market changes, operational disruptions, or cybersecurity.
* Create a real\-time, enterprise\-wide dashboard that consolidates all key risk metrics for better oversight and transparency.
* Develop and deliver outreach and engagement activities in support of embedding and strengthening risk management culture and awareness.
* Engage more deeply with middle management and front\-line staff to embed risk awareness and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Delivering impactful risk management training.
* Recommend professional certifications and ERM training syllabus for skill enhancement among ERM professionals.
* Encourage your team to pursue certifications in advanced risk management, sustainability, or digital tools to improve their skillsets.
* Actively participate in risk forums and discussions with senior management to align risk strategies with business goal.
* Other business units/functions – Execute and deliver initiatives on a regular basis to identify unique/emerging risks and design risk management strategies to address the risks identified.
* Perform adhoc independent risk review and validation for any request on Group’s undertakings.
* Develop ERM risk reporting/dashboard, timely communicate/escalate risk events, issues, and compliance with risk policies and limits to key stakeholders in the Company and in the region; manage the Company’s quarterly risk reporting.
* Regularly review the Risk Management framework and the operating structure for identifying, assessing, managing and monitoring the risks.
* Execute the annual Risk Management processes with key business, stakeholders, update the risk assessment and ensure adequate measures are in place to mitigate the identified risks.
* Monitor the risk appetite, identifying key risk management strategies, assessing and profiling of the key risks affecting the achievement of the business plans at group, business division and at a department level.
* Develop, refine and review the Risk Register and evaluate the relevance of risks identified across business units in the Group.
* Assist Senior Management team in improving risk management / mitigating strategies and techniques, and carrying out follow up action plans and its effectiveness in mitigating / controlling risks.
* Review and evaluate the effectiveness of implementation of action plans for risk management \- provide assurance on whether the risk mitigation process is being driven effectively and efficiently, whilst also continuously monitoring of whether the risk register is being updated appropriately.
* Evaluate and draw attention to possible gaps in the risk register to the Senior Management and Head of Services \- follow\-up on the development of control environment to overcome deficiencies in the risk management / mitigating process.
* Collaborate working with relevant functions (e.g. Risk Management, Internal Audit, Finance and Legal) to build up and/or implement a risk control framework (i.e. compliance self\-assessment) and provide quality and solutions\-focused advice on risk and control issues relevant to the business division for informed decision\-making on compliance and ethics matters.

* Act as a key support to the CRO/HEAD GRCI in representing the GRCI in board meetings, committees, and industry forums
* Represent the CRO/HEAD in Management meetings, committees, or forums when required.

* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the implementation of whistleblowing mechanisms, ethics training programs, and conflict of interest management processes.

**Job Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant, Certified Risk Professional, Certified Integrity Officer (CeIO) would be an added advantage

**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics.
